title: 1723 When reasoning meets information aggregation: a case study with sports narratives
improvement: Adopt the DCA metric and divide-and-conquer batching (DnC-10-style) as GSE's standard for aggregating LLM-generated game narratives, then extend past the paper by measuring the team-to-player attribution accuracy gap and mapping accuracy-per-dollar across batch sizes to pick the Pareto-optimal production batching.
gate: ADAPT proceeds if the NFL replication shows the same qualitative pattern (batching helps, dense scoring hurts, symbolic substitution hurts); REJECT monolithic inference for any GSE aggregation task

title: T-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Trajectory Similarity Computation
improvement: Build a T-JEPA-style trajectory encoder for NFL tracking with relative (ball/LOS-referenced) coordinates into AdjFuse and play-phase-conditioned mask tokens, replacing absolute-grid encodings and linear interpolation for masked-frame position imputation and same-play-concept retrieval.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) AdjFuse-augmented model achieves ≥15% lower masked-frame position RMSE than linear interpolation on held-out weeks, OR (b) T-JEPA embeddings reach same-play-concept top-1 accuracy ≥35% (vs ≤15% random, ≥10pp over raw-DTW). REJECT if neither holds.

title: The Impact of Expert Interaction Networks on Forecast Pooling
improvement: Rebuild the GSE ensemble so component models draw on diversified information channels (not just diversified model classes), and add a variance audit that caps the single most-shared input (NGS features, injury reports, market lines) since shared channels inflate pooled-forecast variance with zero bias reduction, worst in star topologies.
gate: Ledger states no explicit numeric gate; operational check implied by the paper's result: pooled-forecast variance falls when the most-shared input is capped versus uncapped, with no change in pooled bias.

title: Sports Intelligence: Assessing the Sports Understanding Capabilities of Language Models through Question Answering from Text to Video
improvement: Build an NFL-live multi-hop question benchmark auto-generated from fresh game logs (win-probability swings plus down/distance/clock/score context) as a contamination-proof regression test for GSE's content pipeline, using the paper's error taxonomy (nuance confusion, reasoning errors) to route chained sports reasoning to human review where the human gap is quantified.
gate: ADAPT — not a method to adopt but the evaluation discipline GSE's NLP lane was missing: a concrete error taxonomy, a prompting standard with measured gains, and a quantified human-gap that justifies human review on chained sports reasoning.

title: ICM Ensemble with Novel Betting Functions for Concept Drift
improvement: Deploy a weekly ICM concept-drift monitor that uses a market-relative nonconformity score α = |p̂_engine − q_market| on posted picks, so it tests exchangeability of the edge distribution and fires when GSE's edge regime decays (e.g., the market catching up to an angle) instead of tracking raw accuracy.
gate: ADAPT if the offline replay fires an alarm within 3 weeks of the 2024 kickoff-rule change on the TOTALS stream with ≤1 false alarm per season on 2024–2026 data — then deploy the monitor as a weekly cron job feeding the recalibration queue. Reject if alarms are dominated by noise (≥3 false alarms/season) or if detection latency exceeds 6 weeks.

title: Decentralized Transformers with Centralized Aggregation are Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent World Models (MARIE)
improvement: Build a MARIE-style decentralized imagination world model for NFL plays with a role-structured Perceiver aggregator (separate query heads for skill players, linemen, defenders, ball) to predict +0.5s player positions and counterfactual EPA under route-swap edits for the what-if content engine.
gate: ADOPT if on held-out 2024 plays: (a) imagined +0.5s position error ≤ 0.9 yards (beats constant-velocity by ≥25%), AND (b) EPA-bucket within-1 accuracy ≥ 60%, AND (c) counterfactual sign agreement ≥ 65% on route-swap edits.

title: Exploring the Difficulty of Estimating Win Probability: A Simulation Study
improvement: Replace the standard bootstrap on the win-probability model with a game-clustered bootstrap (and extend to drive-nested hierarchical resampling), because game-level clustering is what determines whether WP confidence intervals hold their nominal coverage under intra-game dependence.
gate: ADOPT game-clustered resampling if, pre-registered: at the chosen φ, pooled empirical coverage ≥ 0.85 (nominal 90%) with mean width ≤ 1.8× the standard-bootstrap width, on at least 3 of 4 held-out seasons. REJECT φ-tuning (keep simple game-cluster bootstrap, φ = 1) if no φ clears 0.85 coverage or the width penalty exceeds 2×.

title: AlphaForge: A Framework to Mine and Dynamically Combine Formulaic Alpha Factors
improvement: Build a formulaic-alpha mining pipeline that mines factors directly on closing-line residuals (market-adjusted target, not raw cover) and combines the zoo with regime-aware dynamic weights (public-heavy vs sharp-move regimes, selected by a gating model) instead of a static zoo or linear per-step refit.
gate: ADAPT→build if on 2023–2025 test: dynamic combination beats static zoo by ≥ 0.002 Brier AND top-decile weekly signals show hit-rate ≥ 55% ATS (n ≥ 200 games) with deflated-Sharpe > 1.5 under White's reality check across the zoo search.

title: MatchTime: Towards Automatic Soccer Game Commentary Generation
improvement: Port the MatchTime event-to-commentary alignment methodology to NFL: swap CLIP ViT-B/32 for a domain-finetuned encoder, inject player identity via roster/jersey-number vision to fix the anonymity limitation, and extend alignment from commentary to play-by-play text, measuring downstream impact on the GSE event-classifier F1.
gate: ACCEPTED (ADAPT): public datasets + released pipeline + quantified gains on both stages + ablations isolating each component.

title: FootBots: Motion Prediction in Soccer
improvement: Adopt the FootBots decoupled temporal/social set-attention architecture as GSE's tracking-motion backbone with down-aware conditioning (down/distance/yardline/formation embeddings in the context tensor) for motion prediction and counterfactual conditioning in the what-if content engine.
gate: ADOPT the FootBots architecture (decoupled temporal/social set attention) as GSE's tracking-motion backbone if it beats both the independent-LSTM baseline AND the GNS-1953 model on 2024 ADE/FDE; ADOPT CMP for the what-if content engine if counterfactual conditioning produces plausible reactions.

title: A Survey of Data Synthesis Approaches
improvement: Adopt constrained synthetic-play augmentation gated by a learned label-consistency critic (a discriminator predicting whether a synthetic play's assigned label matches a held-out outcome model's assignment), routing only high-critic-confidence synthetics into training instead of rule-based filtering.
gate: ADOPT constrained augmentation only if arm (C) beats BOTH (A) and (B) by ≥ 0.003 Brier on the untouched chronological test window AND the calibration slope stays within [0.9, 1.1] (no miscalibration introduced).

title: Better by Default: Strong Pre-Tuned MLPs and Boosted Trees on Tabular Data
improvement: Ship the paper's pre-tuned (TD) defaults as GSE's default hyperparameter sets for tabular models with algorithm selection over defaults instead of full HPO, and add era-conditional default sets (high- vs low-scoring eras, pre/post rule changes) selected by a cheap era classifier to capture non-stationarity.
gate: ADOPT if: paper-TD defaults beat library defaults by ≥0.002 log-loss on 2021–2025 without any search, AND algorithm selection over defaults reaches within 0.002 of full HPO at ≤20% of the compute.

title: PEP: Tackle Value as Prevented Expected Points
improvement: Score tackles as prevented expected points via the counterfactual-removal GAMLSS, and close the authors' gap by scoring missed tackles with the inverted counterfactual on charted missed-tackle events to build a net tackling metric (PEP_made − PEP_missed), splitting the mixed model by run/pass to remove CB catch-and-tackle bias, as an input to defensive player ratings.
gate: ADAPT if: (a) RF out-of-sample EOPY predictions achieve MAE ≤ 3.5 yards on held-out weeks (paper: 3.13), and (b) the tackler random intercept predicts second-half tackles per snap with out-of-sample R² ≥ 0.05 above the raw-tackle-rate baseline.

title: Diff-MTS: Temporal-Augmented Conditional Diffusion for Multivariate Time Series
improvement: Adopt Diff-MTS as GSE's primary trajectory/panel generator with matchup-graph conditioning (week's opponent-strength/home-away graph embedding in the condition vector) and apply the Ada-MMD regularizer to the cross-team correlation structure of the denoised output, not just noise distributions.
gate: ADOPT Diff-MTS as the lane's primary trajectory generator if: (a) discriminative score <0.75 on NFL data, AND (b) predictive-score RMSE within 15% of real-trained on held-out seasons, AND (c) condition consistency ≥80%.

title: The Madness of Multiple Entries in March Madness
improvement: Replace max-EV 150-entry GPP construction with the paper's expected-maximum-score (EMS) portfolio optimizer using SAA/PROP+ greedy heuristics, extended to field-aware EMS that maximizes P(best entry beats the field's best entry) against K synthetic sharp entries so portfolios gain contrarian leverage instead of raw EMS alone.
gate: Adopt the EMS portfolio optimizer if on 2024 backtests the G-SAA or PROP+ 150-entry portfolio beats the 150×-max-EV baseline on simulated EMS by ≥5.0 points AND on realized best-entry finish percentile by ≥5 percentile points across ≥10 slates; reject if the SAA MILP doesn't solve within 30 minutes per slate.

title: Improving Probabilistic Forecasts of Extreme Wind Speeds by Training Statistical Post-Processing Models with Weighted Scoring Rules
improvement: Train GSE's weather post-processing models with tail-weighted twCRPS plus pooled EMOS-style combination, but set the weight threshold at value-weighted points (totals near key numbers, regions of historically largest GSE edge) rather than climatological quantiles, so the tail focus lands where the money is.
gate: ADOPT the twCRPS + pooling pipeline if the 90th-percentile twCRPS skill gain is ≥1% with body degradation ≤0.5% on the 2024–2025 test; REJECT pure-twCRPS training (no pooling) if body CRPS degrades >1%.

title: Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus Models for Evaluating and Scouting Football (Soccer) Players using Possession Sequences
improvement: Rebuild GSE's drive-level NFL player ratings as group-lasso regularized plus-minus on possession segments (position-group penalties, separating on-ball and off-ball contributions) with expected-points value targets instead of binary indicators, using the train-ratings→predict-games validity protocol to turn player ratings into game predictions.
gate: Rebuild on one NFL season of drive data: require group lasso ≥ ridge on Brier score for held-out games, and both significantly better than an ELO-only baseline at 10% (paired t-test); improvement experiment success = Brier-score improvement ≥ 5% over the goal-indicator version.

title: Aircraft Trajectory Segmentation-based Contrastive Coding (ATSCC)
improvement: Learn NFL route-concept primitives with ATSCC-style segment contrastive coding using hierarchical RDP segmentation (coarse ε for play phases, fine ε within segments) plus cross-player segment contrast so same break types across different players form a position-agnostic break vocabulary for few-shot route classification.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) ATSCC-style segment embeddings achieve NMI ≥ 0.40 against charted route concepts on held-out weeks (vs ≤ 0.30 for TS2Vec), AND (b) segment boundaries match charted break points with F1 ≥ 0.50.

title: Kairosis: dynamical probability forecast aggregation via Bayesian change-point detection
improvement: Aggregate GSE's forecast streams (engine probability snapshots, market, weather) with Kairosis Bayesian change-point time-weighting so midweek information-regime shifts (injury news) re-weight the stream, extended to first detect change points then fuse sources within the post-change regime via inverse-covariance intersection (time-aware AND correlation-aware aggregation).
gate: Kairosis median achieves positive skill vs uniform median benchmark on both Brier and log-loss across the pick set; margin should exceed the paper's ~0.04–0.06 skill units to justify the added machinery.

title: FIVB ranking: Misstep in the right direction
improvement: Audit GSE's team-rating weights by testing equal weights against current weights on season-blocked log-loss (drop/dampen any weight that loses), adopt the ordinal margin-of-victory Elo likelihood if margin earns its keep, and extend to a score-driven dynamic-ordinal model (AR(1) strength dynamics fused with the ordinal MOV likelihood) so form swings and margin information live in one rating.
gate: Adopt the audit's recommendations if, on season-blocked CV, equal weights beat GSE's current weights on log-loss (then drop/dampen the weights) AND the ordinal-MOV model beats binary Elo on win-probability log-loss by ≥0.005.

title: Flow with FlorDB: Incremental Context Maintenance for the Machine Learning Lifecycle
improvement: Adopt FlorDB-style incremental context logging for the GSE pipeline and extend it with content-addressed run manifests (code SHA plus content hashes of every input dataset snapshot), so any past pick is reproducible as (code sha, data hashes) — completing the public-record audit story the paper's code-only versioning misses.
gate: ADOPT the convention iff the retroactive-question test scores 5/5 within the time bound AND logging overhead adds <2% to pipeline wall-clock time (measured over one full weekly cycle). REJECT (fall back to ad-hoc logging) if overhead exceeds 5% or if fewer than 4/5 questions are answerable.

title: OneLove beyond the field: A few-shot pipeline for topic and sentiment analysis during the FIFA World Cup in Qatar
improvement: Adapt the few-shot topic/stance pipeline into the signal desk for NFL injury/trade storylines, upgraded with retrieval-augmented few-shot (the 3 most similar labeled tweets from a growing GSE gold bank as in-context examples) so the pipeline becomes self-improving week over week.
gate: ADAPT into the signal desk if the pilot clears 70% stance accuracy on NFL injury/trade storylines with per-class F1 ≥ 0.55 on the minority class; REJECT if the "against/denial" class can't be labeled reliably (κ < 0.5).

title: 1718 Sportify: question answering with embedded visualizations and personified narratives for sports video
improvement: Port the evidence-grounding pattern (question → retrieved play → tactic classification → embedded visualization → sourced stats) into GSE's video/content QA as retrieve → telestrate → narrate, replacing KNN+FastDTW with GSE charting labels and running a controlled factuality experiment on every claim in generated narrations to justify the third-person-only rule.
gate: ADAPT the evidence-grounding pattern, not the paper's components: KNN+FastDTW on 134 clips, SportsVU dependence, and first-person narration are all rejected for GSE use. ADAPT proceeds if the reproducible test shows comprehension gains without factual errors.

title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
improvement: Run a nightly AI-Scientist-style agent loop that proposes, implements, and backtests new NFL signals, with an evolutionary archive and cross-run memory so the idea generator composes/mutates past successful signals (weather × matchup interactions) instead of proposing from scratch, promoting only signals that clear the sports gate with byte-identical reproducibility.
gate: **ADOPT the agent into production if:** (a) ≥3 agent-generated signals pass the **promotion gate of ΔBrier ≥ 0.002 vs baseline on the 2025 held-out season** (the task's mandated sports gate), with zero non-reproducible results (every promoted signal's log re-runs byte-identical), and (b) the reviewer agent's accept/reject decisions agree with a human analyst on ≥80% of a 20-idea calibration set. **REJECT (return to lab) if** fewer than 3 signals clear the gate in 30 nights, or any promoted signal fails reproducibility, or the agent bypasses a sandbox constraint (runaway process / constraint editing — the paper's Section 8 safety failure modes — triggers immediate shutdown of that run).

title: MambaTrack: A Simple Baseline for Multiple Object Tracking with State Space Model
improvement: Replace the Kalman baseline for NFL trajectory prediction with a per-role hierarchical Mamba predictor (shared bi-Mamba encoder plus QB/RB/WR/TE/DB/LB heads with an interaction term), and feed its 1-second-ahead predicted positions into the pressure/STRAIN calculations to test whether anticipated pressure predicts sacks better than realized pressure.
gate: ADAPT if MTP (or its per-role variant) beats the Kalman baseline by ≥15% mean displacement error on held-out NFL tracking frames AND inference stays <50 ms/frame on GSE hardware; otherwise REJECT (Kalman remains the cheaper choice).

title: Bye-Bye, Bye Advantage: Estimating the competitive impact of rest differential in the National Football League
improvement: Add rest-differential features to the spread model (bye/mini-bye effects plus travel-distance/timezone interactions, TNF-specific rest bins, and altitude), then target the residual mispricing in specific schedule spots (e.g., road teams off bye vs home teams off bye) to build a rest-differential betting system.
gate: Adopt as permanent spread-model features if replication on 2015–2024 confirms post-2011 bye PD effect <1.0 pt/game with market pricing ≥0.5 pts above it; if the market has corrected (pricing ≈ reality), keep features but drop the anti-bye angle.

title: Prompto: An open source library for asynchronous querying of LLM endpoints
improvement: Adopt Prompto as GSE's standard async multi-model LLM query harness and extend it with per-experiment spend tracking (tokens in/out per model, cost per 100 prompts reconciled against provider invoices) so large prompt experiments carry first-class cost visibility.
gate: ADOPT Prompto as the standard multi-model query harness iff it completes the 100-prompt × 2-model test ≥5× faster than the synchronous baseline with zero dropped responses and per-endpoint QPM respected (no 429s).

title: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
improvement: Make conditioning noise augmentation a mandatory training stabilizer for all GSE autoregressive game simulators, with hierarchical conditioning (short play window plus a compressed drive-level summary vector) so score/timeout/field-position state persists without lengthening the attention window.
gate: ADOPT conditioning noise augmentation as a mandatory training stabilizer for ALL GSE autoregressive simulators if it flattens the 64-play divergence curve by ≥30% vs baseline on 2024 held-out games.

title: TrajFM: A Vehicle Trajectory Foundation Model for Region and Task Transferability
improvement: Build a football-native trajectory foundation model replacing the paper's POI-text embeddings with learned field-landmark embeddings (yard lines, hash marks, end zones) and extend relative rotary attention across players (ball-carrier query, defender keys) so the same mechanism gives region transfer and formation-agnostic interaction modeling.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) frozen model matches per-task fine-tuned baselines within 5% on all three tasks, AND (b) cross-season (2024) performance degrades ≤ 10% vs in-season (2023) on trajectory prediction.

title: FastBO: Fast HPO and NAS with Adaptive Fidelity Identification
improvement: Adopt FastBO's adaptive fidelity identification for GSE hyperparameter searches and NAS so configs are early-stopped at learned efficient points, and meta-learn the δ thresholds themselves from config + dataset features (GSE-TabRepo log) to get zero-shot fidelity predictions before any evaluation.
gate: ADOPT if: adaptive fidelity reaches within 0.001 log-loss of the full-evaluation best config using ≤50% of the season-fits of fixed halving, with no config wrongly early-terminated (check: no top-5 full-evaluation config killed in warm-up).

title: Upselling in Online Fantasy Sports: Dream11 Experiments and Causal Policy
improvement: Replace fixed-arm fantasy upsell experiments with the paper's pre-registered dual-margin design upgraded to Thompson-sampling contextual bandit assignment across the four upsell intensities, minimizing regret during the experiment itself.
gate: ADAPT the experiment design if: a pre-registered dual-margin experiment shows ≥5% revenue-per-visitor lift with conversion decline <1 pp over ≥4 weeks. REJECT the CATE-assignment half if offline uplift estimates cannot be replicated in a live A/B — ship only the best uniform arm.

title: Shrouded Sin Taxes
improvement: Add effective-price accounting to the engine's CLV/edge pipeline as honesty infrastructure (detecting when shrouded fees flip posted +EV picks to effective −EV), and use per-book posted-vs-effective margin gaps as a line-selection feature that preferentially targets slow-moving high-gap books.
gate: Adopt effective-price accounting in the engine's CLV/edge pipeline if sign flips occur on ≥2% of positive-EV picks for any tracked book (posted +EV → effective −EV). If flips are <2% across all books, log the discipline as verified-unnecessary and keep posted-price accounting.

title: Partial Membership Models for Soft Clustering of Multivariate Football Player Performance Data
improvement: Adopt Bayesian partial-membership soft clustering for GSE's hybrid-role player representations (fractional role memberships with archetype anchoring instead of blended mixture components), upgrading the paper's independent Poissons with a negative-binomial overdispersion layer and a random-walk temporal prior on memberships across season windows.
gate: Gate (ADAPT): WAICm 99/100 correct-K recovery; PM yields true archetypes where MM maxes at 0.686 membership. Improvement success = WAICm improvement ≥ 2% on the same Serie A data and archetype stability (same 4 archetypes) with runtime ≤ 12 h.

title: Causal effect of the infield shift in the MLB
improvement: Adopt the matching + IPTW + preference-IV triangulation as GSE's standard template for causal evaluation of NFL strategic/rule interventions from observational data, upgrading the paper's 2SLS linearity with a doubly robust / double-ML ETT (cross-fitted ML nuisance models) and estimating the league-wide ATE, not just the ETT.
gate: ADAPT the triangulation template if the NFL kickoff replication shows sign agreement between IPTW and IV, post-weighting |SMD| < 0.1, first-stage partial F > 100, and the placebo-year ETT has 95% CI covering 0. REJECT if estimators disagree in sign or the placebo test fails.

title: IIFE: Interaction Information Based Automated Feature Engineering
improvement: Add an interaction-information pair-prior to GSE's automated feature engineering for LightGBM with a two-stage screen (stage 1: II for all pairs with no prefilter; stage 2: conditional-II given the current pool) to fix the paper's XOR-blindspot, and make the bivariate candidate set sports-native (rest-differential × matchup, weather × dome/outdoor, divisional-rematch adjustments).
gate: ADAPT the II pair-prior iff (a) 2024 held-out log-loss improves ≥ 0.003 for LightGBM, AND (b) the II-prioritized arm beats the random-pair arm by ≥ 0.002, AND (c) the transductive-control arm demonstrably inflates (confirming the audit can detect the bug class).

title: Moving from Machine Learning to Statistics: Expected Points in American Football
improvement: Rebuild GSE's EPA model with the full package (opponent-quality adjustment, 1/N_i drive-length weighting, game-cluster bootstrap) and add a catalytic prior that shrinks toward market-implied scoring expectations by game-state instead of plain logistic regression, producing a smoothed, market-consistent EPA that tightens spread/total residuals.
gate: Adopt the full package (quality adjustment + 1/N_i weighting + cluster bootstrap) if the weighted model beats unweighted on 2023–2024 log-loss and bootstrap CIs achieve ≥93% coverage; adopt the catalytic prior only if it removes monotonicity artifacts at <0.5% log-loss cost.

title: Rating Players of Counter-Strike: Global Offensive Based on Plus/Minus value
improvement: Build snap-level adjusted plus-minus player ratings for NFL with a hierarchical model (unit-level random effects for OL and secondary so individual APM is estimated net of unit effects), running the ridge vs elastic net vs Bayesian-with-PFF-prior vs Bayesian-with-shrunk-prior ablation the paper never ran.
gate: ADOPT snap-APM if, on the 2024 season walk-forward test, adding player APM coefficients improves play-EPA out-of-sample R² by ≥ 0.01 AND the top-decile offensive APM players beat their yardage prop lines at a rate exceeding the baseline model by ≥ 2 percentage points (hit-rate lift on ≥ 200 graded props).

title: QuantFactor REINFORCE: Mining Steady Formulaic Alpha Factors with Variance-bounded REINFORCE
improvement: Mine formulaic NFL alphas with variance-bounded REINFORCE where candidate formulas are shaped by forward-walk information ratio (worst-fold expanding-window IC as the reward, not training-window IR) and co-mine small factor sets jointly with a diversity bonus instead of mining single factors one by one.
gate: ADAPT→build if QFR-miner beats GP by ≥ 20% relative RankIC on the 2022–2025 test block with ≤ the same GPU budget AND the top-10 mined factors each pass a White's-reality-check gate (p < 0.05) on the test block.

title: Analyzing and Forecasting Success in the Men's Ice Hockey World (Junior) Championships Using a Dynamic Ranking Model
improvement: Adopt the score-driven dynamic Plackett-Luce model for GSE's pre-season standings forecasts, replacing modal-rank evaluation with expected-rank metrics (E[rank_i], P(rank_i ≤ k) from 10k simulated draws per season) so model selection uses a defensible rank-accuracy metric instead of unreliable modal-rank MAE.
gate: Adopt the score-driven dynamic PL for GSE's pre-season standings model if, on 2015–2025 rolling forecasts, the AIC-final penalized model beats the static model on average log-likelihood by ≥0.05/season AND achieves P(division winner) ≥ market-implied baseline within 0.03.

title: A Bayesian framework for analyzing alleged cheating in sports through hidden codes
improvement: Deploy the likelihood-ratio anomaly detector as GSE's game-integrity monitor, extended from fixed per-case priors to a hierarchical model over referee crews with partial pooling so signal probability and honest baselines are learned jointly across crews, including crews with little history.
gate: ADOPT the monitor if the LR detector catches at least as many labeled anomalous games as the z-score baseline with no more than 1/2 the false-positive rate on the 2025 weeks 1–3 window; REJECT otherwise.

title: A Convolutional Neural Network-based Ensemble Post-processing with Data Augmentation for Tropical Cyclone Precipitation Forecasts
improvement: Add data-augmented CNN ensemble post-processing to GSE's weather pipeline with stadium-specific post-processors (conditioned on bowl openness and elevation) to fix the paper's mountain-grid failure, and apply the same augmentation to dual-resolution wind tails where truncated-normal EMOS is weakest.
gate: ADOPT if augmentation improves Brier score at tail thresholds by ≥ 5% on hold-out extreme games. REJECT if no gain.

title: Dynamic quantification of player value for fantasy basketball
improvement: Ship H-scoring-style dynamic drafting in GSE's fantasy products, upgrading the paper's static-rank opponent assumption with a mixture over real opponent archetypes (punters, position-runners, value drafters) fit from actual ADP data.
gate: ADOPT H-scoring-style dynamic drafting if, across 1,000 simulated seasons per seat, it beats static-rank drafting by ≥5 percentage points of playoff rate with SE ≤ 1.6%. Reject if the gain concentrates only in top seats.

title: Predicting soccer matches with complex networks and machine learning
improvement: Run an ablation experiment fusing the paper's network-centrality metric set (per-quarter networks, flow motifs, dynamic node sets for in-game personnel changes) into NGS target networks with 3-class cover/push/no-cover modeling, using strictly time-ordered splits to fix the paper's leakage risk.
gate: Reproduction criterion: reimplement on the Pappalardo dataset with time-ordered replication; verdict rationale — a modest, honest paper with no direct NFL method, so the transfer bar is an ablation showing incremental gain on NGS target networks.

title: Causal Feature Selection Method for Contextual Multi-Armed Bandits in Recommender System
improvement: Select pick/staking-model features with causal HIE/HDD instead of correlation, extended to continuous graded rewards (ROI per pick via per-bin reward densities) and time-varying HIE in rolling 4-week windows, feeding the changepoint-resetting bandit from ledger 0810 to close the loop between feature selection and non-stationary model selection.
gate: ADAPT if on the GSE 2025 holdout replay (a) HIE/HDD rank a known-spurious correlate (e.g., raw team win%) below true HTE features like line-movement buckets, AND (b) the LinUCB selector using HIE/HDD top features beats the correlation-selected selector by ≥ 1.5 ROI points per 100 picks.

title: On the Extrapolation of Generative Adversarial Networks for Downscaling Precipitation Extremes in Warmer Climates
improvement: Justify generative extreme-weather simulation for GSE game-impact scenarios using the paper's 77%-vs-65% historical-training result as the evidence that GAN tails extrapolate without future data, then condition the generator on large-scale circulation indices (ENSO/NAO) and ensemble GAN seeds to measure tail-spread calibration, testing diffusion downscalers against the GAN on the same capture-fraction metric.
gate: ADAPT: the 77%-vs-65% historical-training result is exactly the evidence GSE needs to justify generative extreme-weather simulation — tails that extrapolate without future data (ledger states no further numeric gate).

title: Efficient Feature Interactions with Transformers: Improving User Spending Propensity Predictions in Gaming
improvement: Replace the paper's fixed t±5 positional contextual windows with time-decayed contextual features (exponential decay on game-clock distance, explicit inter-play time gaps as token features) for drive-outcome prediction, and add isotonic/temperature-scaled calibration with ECE reporting that the paper ignored.
gate: ADAPT in two stages. Stage 1 (features): adopt the t±5 contextual-window features if challenger A beats baseline XGBoost on 2023–2024 test MAE by ≥ 1% with non-overlapping 10-seed intervals. Stage 2 (architecture): adopt the transformer only if challenger B beats *both* baseline and challenger A by ≥ 1% MAE *and* the inference cost passes the ledger's latency check.

title: Bayesian Bivariate Conway-Maxwell-Poisson Regression Model for Correlated Count Data in Sports
improvement: Add the bivariate Conway-Maxwell-Poisson as a totals-modeling option with time-varying (random-walk) dispersion so variance itself is predictable (e.g., weather-driven variance inflation in wind games), extended to a multivariate CMP over (home points, away points, home turnovers, away turnovers) for a joint spread/total/turnover model.
gate: Adopt CMP as a totals-modeling option if, on the reproducible test, its out-of-sample joint log-loss beats bivariate Poisson and NB (or ties with demonstrably better tail calibration) and a full-season fit runs in <24 h on GSE hardware.

title: The Craft of Selective Prediction: Towards Reliable Case Outcome Classification
improvement: Add MC-dropout plus certainty-based rejection (CER) selective prediction to the engine with γ learned per market type, so GSE abstains on low-confidence picks at fixed coverage; if the abstention moves metrics but not ROI, keep it as a risk–coverage monitoring layer rather than a selection change.
gate: ADAPT bar: MC-dropout + CER must beat the current single-pass baseline on AURCC and realized ROI at fixed coverage on a hold-out season; if only the metrics move but ROI doesn't, adopt the abstention machinery as a monitoring layer (risk–coverage reporting) rather than a selection change.

title: RisingBALLER: A Player is a Token, a Match is a Sentence — A Path Towards a Foundational Model for Football Players Data Analytics
improvement: Pre-train a player-as-token foundation model on NFL event data with two-tower pre-training (masked player-token prediction plus masked game-context prediction, masking the opponent's defensive stats to force offense-vs-defense interaction embeddings), earning a place in the projection stack.
gate: ADAPT if Test 1 passes (embeddings capture real player structure) AND Test 2 shows ≥5% MAE improvement. REJECT if MPP accuracy is near chance or downstream gains are <2%.

title: Deep Learning for Action Spotting in Association Football Videos
improvement: Build a two-stream (video + NGS tracking coordinates as auxiliary neck input) action spotter for NFL core classes (snap, handoff, pass release, off-ball actions) as GSE's charting pipeline, which neither pure-video nor pure-tracking methods can match on unshown/off-ball actions.
gate: Adopt (proceed to scale-up) if the fine-tuned spotter reaches mAP@1 ≥ 0.60 on the 3 held-out NFL games for the core classes (snap, handoff, pass release). Reject/shelve otherwise.

title: FanCric: Multi-Agentic Framework for Crafting Fantasy 11 Cricket Teams
improvement: Add a multi-agent context layer to the weekly DFS pipeline where each agent's qualitative signal enters as a prior with explicit uncertainty calibrated from 2024 backtest hit rates, with reliability-weighted shrinkage damping the hallucinated signals while keeping the useful fraction of context adjustments.
gate: ADOPT the context-agent layer into the weekly DFS pipeline only if it beats the projection-only MILP baseline by ≥ 3 percentile points over a full 17-week backtest AND the per-player multiplier JSON is auditable (every multiplier traceable to a cited data source — no LLM-invented narratives).

title: A Report on Semantic-Guided RL for Interpretable Feature Engineering (SMART)
improvement: Deploy semantic-guided RL feature engineering with SWRL semantic veto and temporal leakage rules, and test the untested transfer claim by freezing the KG-grounded state encoder trained on the NFL panel and transferring the policy to a CFB panel to get a multi-sport FE policy for one sport's exploration budget.
gate: ADAPT if: ≥0.003 held-out NFL log-loss improvement on 2025 games versus the raw-features baseline, zero semantically invalid features in the final set (SWRL veto pass), no post-kickoff leakage, and mean human interpretability rating ≥4.0/5.0 on the top-20 features.

title: Continuous Ensemble Weather Forecasting with Diffusion Models
improvement: Adopt a continuous-trajectory diffusion weather forecaster for in-game conditions, conditioned on the pregame spread/total as a market-consistency constraint so the same ensemble stays calibrated to the closing line and serves both live-betting win probability and pregame pricing.
gate: ADOPT the continuous-trajectory forecaster if, on 2024, its CRPS at 30- and 60-minute leads beats the per-horizon baselines by ≥5% AND sampled trajectories are monotone-coherent (no lead-time crossing artifacts in ≥95% of sampled members).

title: SPORTU: A Comprehensive Sports Understanding Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models
improvement: Fine-tune an open video model on GSE's NFL clip annotations with direct-answer training (no CoT) to test whether domain tuning closes the gap to proprietary models at ~1/50th inference cost, and gate any video model entering the content pipeline on ≥65% NFL-split MCQs and open-ended G-Eval ≥ 2.5.
gate: Route any video model into the content pipeline only if it scores ≥65% on the NFL split MCQs AND its open-ended G-Eval ≥ 2.5 — otherwise keep the human-in-the-loop workflow.

title: Modeling and Prediction of the UEFA EURO 2024 via Combined Statistical Learning Approaches
improvement: Upgrade the pregame spread/total pipeline to a bivariate-Poisson combined score model (correlation ρ estimated per matchup-total band) and extend it in-game by re-estimating (λ₁,λ₂) from the pregame ensemble plus live score/clock state each minute with a short 10k-sim Monte Carlo, capturing the garbage-time correlation that independence assumptions miss.
gate: Adopt the enhanced-variable + ensemble pipeline if the combined score model beats the engine's current spread/total probability layer on Brier score for game winner AND margin MAE over 2023–2024 by ≥0.003 / ≥0.15 points respectively, with the logability (market-consensus) variable showing positive permutation importance.

title: Convergence and stationary distribution of Elo rating systems
improvement: Schedule GSE's Elo K-factors from the paper's √K scaling frontier (making K choices from an explicit error budget) and apply an empirically estimated bias curve E[X]−ρ (final Elo vs next-season win total, 2015–2025) as a shrinkage correction to preseason Elo — a debiased Elo the authors themselves list as desirable future work.
gate: Adopt the √K frontier for K-factor scheduling if the 2015–2025 fit yields R² ≥ 0.6 on the √K regression of team-level rating dispersion. Reject if the relationship fails (R² < 0.3).

title: Time to Retrain? Detecting Concept Drifts in Machine Learning Systems
improvement: Deploy a two-stage concept-drift detector in the weekly cron: stage 1 pre-game inspector-disagreement PHT on the upcoming slate as a cheap early filter, stage 2 post-game PUDD chi-square on the resolved PU-index, trading weak precision for combination specificity on retrain decisions.
gate: ADOPT the inspector monitor if on 2020–2025 nflverse: (i) PHT disagreement alarms precede ≥50% of labeled regime-change episodes by ≥1 week, (ii) ≤2 false alarms per season, (iii) refit-on-alarm does not degrade Brier by more than 0.002 vs frozen baseline on non-alarm weeks, and (iv) the pipeline runs end-to-end in the weekly cron in <5 minutes.

title: Predicting Chess Puzzle Difficulty with Transformers
improvement: Replace fixed Gaussian label-noise clipping in GSE's spread-margin models with a two-component label-noise mixture (Gaussian plus heavy-tailed component for known noisy regimes like backup-QB games and extreme weather), with the mixture weight a function of game metadata (roster flags, wind), so the outliers are modeled explicitly instead of clipped away.
gate: Adopt if any of: (a) sampled-target model reduces held-out MAE on 2023–2024 by ≥ 0.15 points vs the identical point-target baseline (averaged over 5 seeds), or (b) the MAZ analogue improves ≥ 3% relative while MAE does not worsen; improvement experiment adds per-slice (weather/roster-flag) MAZ improvement ≥ 5%.

title: Neural Symbolic Regression of Complex Network Dynamics
improvement: Discover symbolic laws of NFL team dynamics with PIND-style coordinated search (F and G skeletons recovered separately) on time-varying matchup graphs with edge features (rest differential, travel distance, weather), training across 2015–2024 and freezing the equations to transfer-test on 2024–2025 without refitting constants.
gate: ADAPT if: on synthetic league data, coordinated search recovers both F and G skeletons in ≥ 8/10 seeds (vs ≤ 5/10 for joint search) AND on real 2025 data the F+G model matches the engine's spread MAE within 0.3 points. Transfer success = equations transfer with < 5% MAE degradation.

title: Conformal Predictive Portfolio Selection
improvement: Build DFS portfolio selection on conformal predictive intervals with a cost-aware high-risk/low-risk rule: select the maximum upper bound among low-risk candidates after subtracting expected rake and fading high-ownership lineups, correcting the paper's frictionless 3-asset orientation (verified against the sign error in an A/B) before it ever touches real slates.
gate: ADOPT the corrected rule if it beats projection-maximizing selection on 2024–2025 ROI with statistical significance (paired test over slates); REJECT the paper's as-written orientation if the A/B shows the literal lowest-r version underperforms (confirming the sign error).

title: SELA: Tree-Search Enhanced LLM Agents for Automated Machine Learning
improvement: Upgrade the nightly signal-discovery agent with SELA-style MCTS structured as a hierarchy over signal families (matchup / weather / rest / market / special-teams as level-1 branches, hypotheses as level-2) with progressive widening, so thin-lane winners like special teams and referees get explicitly budgeted early exploration instead of being starved.
gate: ADOPT if: MCTS arm finds ≥1.5× the gate-passing signals of round-robin at equal budget, wasted rollouts drop by ≥30%, and the tree's value estimates correlate (Spearman ≥ 0.5) with final holdout scores. REJECT if MCTS ≈ round-robin within 20%.

title: A Systematic Review of Machine Learning in Sports Betting: Techniques, Challenges, and Future Directions
improvement: Use the review only as a pointer list to cited primary papers, and run the meta-analysis the review never did — pooled distribution of reported ROI across its 219 studies with publication-bias adjustment — plus the calibration-vs-accuracy bake-off internally on NFL data as engine-honesty infrastructure.
gate: For the review as evidence: REJECT as a source of conclusions (narrative, unverified, no pooling) — accept only as a pointer list. Promote a cited primary paper to deep-read only if it is retrievable and contains an auditable experiment.

title: Joint Training for Selective Prediction
improvement: Jointly train the predictor and the abstention gate with a policy-gradient term (JTSP) and make the deferral head stake-aware — outputting a continuous stake fraction (0 = abstain) with the policy gradient on risk-adjusted units (Sharpe of weekly P&L) — since sports abstention is really a sizing decision, not a binary one.
gate: ADAPT accepted if JTSP beats the separate-gate Policy baseline by ≥ 2 points of posted-pick hit-rate at matched deferral rate on walk-forward seasons AND the JTSP-vs-JTSP-CE ablation shows the policy-gradient term (not just shared representations) contributes.

title: A Simple and Effective Temporal Grounding Pipeline for Basketball Broadcast Footage
improvement: Add an event-driven scorebug-reading front end to the video lane: a change-detection layer that only OCRs frames where the scorebug region's frame-difference exceeds a threshold, then diffs consecutive reads into a discrete event stream (Q2, 3:42, 3rd&7) — cutting OCR compute ~10× and producing play boundaries directly instead of via timestamp matching.
gate: Adopt as the video lane's alignment stage if ≥90% of plays align within ±2 s of nflverse timestamps on held-out networks (a network not in training must be in the test set); reject if per-network retraining is required.

title: UniTraj: Learning a Universal Trajectory Foundation Model from Billion-Scale Worldwide Traces
improvement: Pre-train a universal NFL trajectory encoder with cross-agent masking (mask an entire player's trajectory and reconstruct it from the other 21 players plus ball) instead of within-trajectory masking, with ball-relative coordinates and play-phase embeddings, so nearest-neighbor retrieval groups plays by defensive coverage concept rather than superficial route shape.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) recovery MAE ≥ 30% lower than linear interpolation on held-out weeks 13–18, OR (b) frozen-encoder + linear-head outcome classification accuracy ≥ 8pp above the from-scratch GRU baseline on held-out weeks.

title: CausalStock: Deep End-to-end Causal Discovery for News-driven Stock Movement Prediction
improvement: Port the denoised-news 5-dimension scoring rubric to NFL news features and use lag-dependent temporal causal discovery to build directed steam-propagation graphs across books, with online/incremental graph updating so steam-leadership can shift within a season (e.g., a book changes its risk desk).
gate: w/o-TCD ablation: 63.42% → 51.08% ACC on ACL18 (MCC 0.2172 → 0.0102). The causal module must prove a comparable ablation gap on GSE line data, or it stays out.

title: GTA-Net: An IoT-Integrated 3D Human Pose Estimation System for Real-Time Adolescent Sports Posture Correction
improvement: Add 3D human pose estimation to the video lane with a broadcast-domain bone-length prior (NFL athlete anthropometrics from combine measurements) as a hard constraint on the Bone-GCN stream, testing whether it closes the MPI-INF-3DHP generalization gap where Yu et al. beat GTA-Net (31.36 vs 48.0 mm).
gate: Reimplementation must land within 2 mm of the paper's Protocol #2 values (CPN: 32.2 mm, GT: 22.3 mm) on Human3.6M, and each ablated component must reproduce the reported degradation pattern, before any GSE integration.

title: GTA: Global Tracklet Association for Multi-Object Tracking in Sports
improvement: Adopt GTA into the NGS-replacement tracking pipeline with a jersey-number-aware ReID connector (auxiliary jersey-number classification head, multi-task identity embedding + number OCR) so the distance matrix separates same-team players by number rather than kit color, using a field-coordinate spatial gate instead of the paper's fixed-camera assumption.
gate: Adopt GTA into the NGS-replacement tracking pipeline if it improves HOTA by ≥3 points and reduces ID switches by ≥15% on the All-22 validation set with the paper's default hyperparameters.

title: SoccerGuard: Injury Prediction Framework
improvement: Adopt the window-sweep injury-prediction protocol but replace fixed rectangular input windows with decay-weighted windows (exponential decay over the past 28 days, decay rate tuned per position group), which nests the paper's 3/5/7-session windows as a special case and keeps long-horizon context while emphasizing recency.
gate: ADOPT the window-sweep protocol iff the best grid cell on the 2025 rolling test achieves TPR ≥ 0.30 at precision ≥ 0.30 with chronological splits.

title: Predictive Modeling of Lower-Level English Club Soccer Using Crowd-Sourced Player Valuations
improvement: Add a crowd-valuation salary-prior overlay to team ratings for early-season and roster-turnover windows, with a per-team adaptive combination weight λ_i = σ(a + b·games played + c·roster turnover) so the market prior matters more where the ratings have seen the fewest games.
gate: ADAPT if Test 1 or Test 2 passes — the salary-prior mechanism earns a role as an early-season/roster-turnover overlay. If λ optimizes to ~1 (prior adds nothing), REJECT the mechanism but keep the disparity-audit practice as a free calibration win.

title: Optimizing Daily Fantasy Baseball Lineups: A Linear Programming Approach for Enhanced Accuracy
improvement: Replace plain projection-maximization in the NFL DFS optimizer with an upper-tail-projection + stacking variant, A/B tested on historical NFL slates with archived contest payouts to quantify how much of the paper's 107.3-point tournament gap it closes at low/mid/high stakes.
gate: On a held-out MLB slate sample: the optimizer's top lineup must outscore the mean of 100 random feasible lineups by ≥ 30 points, and the 25%-exposure portfolio must contain no duplicate lineups.

title: Transformer Neural Process — Kernel Regression
improvement: Adopt the TNP-KR:SA transformer neural process with kernel-biased attention for early-season margin and win-probability prediction, and add an autoregressive multi-game decoding head over the week's slate so the model produces joint slate distributions that unlock correlated parlay/teaser/hedge optimization instead of conditional-independence marginals.
gate: ADOPT iff TNP-KR:SA beats kernel-GP NLL on margin by ≥0.05 nats/game in weeks 1–8 of 2023–2025 AND its win-probability Brier beats the league-average prior by ≥0.01 in the same window; improvement success = better joint log-likelihood on 2–3 game slates than the independent-marginals product with no marginal NLL degradation.

title: The Effects of Major League Baseball's Ban on Infield Shifts: A Quasi-Experimental Analysis
improvement: Adopt the DID+SCM protocol as GSE's standard quasi-experimental toolkit and upgrade it to staggered/event-study DID (align each treated unit on its own event week, never-treated and not-yet-treated controls, full event-time path with uniform confidence bands) so it handles the staggered NFL interventions — injuries, mid-season firings — that the paper's clean 2×2 cannot.
gate: ADOPT the DID+SCM protocol as GSE's standard quasi-experimental toolkit if the kickoff replication (§12) passes its placebo gates; REJECT any substantive conclusion about the shift ban itself as a GSE input.

title: A Graph Neural Network deep-dive into successful counterattacks
improvement: Build a temporal per-frame GNN lane (CrystalConv per frame → temporal attention over a 1-second window) predicting forward-looking play success, adding a scheme-family node/graph feature, to resolve the static model's 40–60% midfield coin-flip problem where single frames cannot read developing leverage.
gate: Adopt the per-frame GNN lane if the scheme-family-specific GNNs beat the pooled GNN by ≥0.02 ROC-AUC on weeks 16–18 AND beat the logistic baseline by ≥0.05 ROC-AUC, with ECE ≤ 0.10 after recalibration.

title: Pretrained LLM Adapted with LoRA as a Decision Transformer for Offline RL in Quantitative Trading
improvement: Treat the season as a decision-transformer trajectory: LoRA-adapt a pretrained LLM on GSE's sequential pick/staking logs, pre-training the backbone cross-domain on public betting-market histories and synthetic Kelly-optimal trajectories to isolate whether the transfer gain comes from generic sequence modeling or language priors.
gate: ADOPT iff on 2024 (a) beats (b) by ≥1pp ROI (transfer works in this domain) AND (a) beats fractional-Kelly by ≥2pp with drawdown no worse; if (a)≈(b), REJECT the pretraining complexity and use the from-scratch DT.

title: Drawdowns of diffusions
improvement: Replace Monte Carlo drawdown gates for the sizer with the closed-form analytic pricer (Brownian-motion-with-drift drawdown laws from Lehoczky/Malyutin/Taylor), running ≥100× faster than Monte Carlo, and extend it to a jump-diffusion so weekly tail losses — not just diffusion wiggle — calibrate against real weekly data.
gate: ADOPT the analytic pricer if its drawdown-probability predictions are calibrated (calibration slope in [0.8, 1.2], Brier within 5% of Monte Carlo) while running ≥ 100× faster than Monte Carlo; REJECT if Laplace inversion is unstable or the BM approximation miscalibrates on real weekly data.

title: Alpha Mining and Enhancing via Warm Start Genetic Programming for Quantitative Investment
improvement: Mine formulaic alphas with warm-start genetic programming constrained to structural templates, adding cross-template restricted crossover (subtree swaps between compatible positions of different templates) and an adaptive template library that retires structures whose enhanced alphas fail the MinervaScore Seal for two consecutive seasons.
gate: ADAPT→build if template-constrained mining yields ≥ 2× the density of test-significant signals (White's p<0.05) per 1,000 evaluations vs. unconstrained GP AND mean pairwise |corr| ≤ 0.65.

title: Node Classification with Integrated Reject Option
improvement: Replace the post-hoc fixed-threshold abstention gate with an integrated (trained-in) reject option and make the coverage target slate-adaptive — a meta-model predicting how many +EV opportunities each slate contains, posting more picks on soft slates and fewer on sharp ones instead of wasting abstention budget at fixed coverage.
gate: ADOPT integrated abstention only if: (a) it beats the fixed-threshold baseline on ROI at the business-chosen coverage, (b) realized coverage stays within ±5 points of target out-of-sample for 4+ consecutive weeks, and (c) the cost-based and coverage-based variants agree on ≥75% of abstain decisions.

title: Understanding the Impact of News Articles on the Movement of Market Index: A Case on Nifty 50
improvement: Replace index-level news sentiment averages with entity-level sentiment: attribute each article's sentiment to specific teams/players via NER plus coreference, then build team-day sentiment features — because in sports, whose news it is matters more than how much news there is.
gate: Adopt if sentiment features reduce RMSE by ≥3% vs the no-news baseline on the embargoed 2024 test AND directional accuracy improves by ≥1pp; reject otherwise.

title: The Causal Effect of the Two-For-One Strategy in the National Basketball Association
improvement: Build GSE's causal-tactics pipeline on the IPW + matching + causal-forest triangulation to evaluate NFL strategic decisions (4th-down go-for-it first), pooling 7+ seasons to test heterogeneity by quarterback tier and coach identity via RATE, with a market-relative outcome (did the decision beat the closing-spread expectation) connecting causal estimates directly to betting value.
gate: ADOPT the causal-tactics pipeline if: (a) on 4th-down go-for-it, IPW and matching ATC estimates both exclude zero with the same sign and |ΔEP| ≥ 0.3 points per decision; (b) all covariates' standardized mean differences <0.1; (c) causal-forest ATE within the IPW 95% CI.

title: Entropy of the Linear Pool and Forecast Disagreement (Krüger, 2024)
improvement: Make linear pooling GSE's combination form on the strength of the paper's exact diversity metric D: compute weekly D (energy-score form) as the ensemble's health monitor and component-selection criterion — maximize disagreement at fixed skill, adding components that increase D rather than ones that agree at matched skill.
gate: On GSE backtests: compute weekly D (energy-score form) and verify Prop 5.1's identity empirically (pooled energy score ≈ average component energy score − D); pass criterion: the identity holds within numerical tolerance and ΔD is a positive predictor of pooled-score improvement; weeks with high D should show the pool's PIT closer to uniform than low-D weeks.

title: Is checking for sequential positivity violations getting you down? Try sPoRT!
improvement: Make sPoRT a mandatory pre-analysis gate for all GSE longitudinal causal work, stabilized with 50 bootstrap refits reporting flag frequency per subgroup instead of a binary flag, each stable flag linked to an automatic remedy (narrow treatment definition, trim subgroup, or switch to a stochastic-intervention estimand) in a generated causal-readiness report.
gate: ADAPT sPoRT as a mandatory pre-analysis gate for longitudinal causal work if the LT test (§12) runs cleanly and surfaces at least one actionable support gap. REJECT it as a standalone deliverable.

title: Buzz to Broadcast: Predicting Sports Viewership Using Social Media Engagement
improvement: Forecast GSE content viewership with a hierarchical Bayesian model — sport-level and team-level random effects plus social-buzz features as population-level predictors — so buzz explains within-tier variation instead of the sport one-hot secretly pooling viewership tiers.
gate: Adopt the feature recipe only if the fixed pipeline beats the team-mean baseline by ≥15% MAE on the 2024 forward test AND held-sport-out R² > 0.5; reject if the signal disappears once the sport one-hot and random split are removed.

title: Fully Test-time Adaptation for Tabular Data (FtaT)
improvement: Add a conditional label-shift correction as a standing pre-game post-processing step: estimate base rates per slate archetype (divisional-heavy slates, bad-weather weeks, prime-time slates) from history and correct each week's predictions against its archetype's base rate, since NFL label shift is structured, not global.
gate: ADOPT the label-shift correction as a standing pre-game post-processing step if on 2020–2025 walk-forward: (i) it reduces slate-level calibration drift (|mean p − base rate|) by ≥30% vs uncorrected, (ii) weekly Brier does not worsen by >0.001, (iii) ECE improves or is neutral.

title: Early Concept Drift Detection via Prediction Uncertainty
improvement: Replace blunt refit-on-alarm with PU-index-weighted forgetting: weight training samples by an exponential forgetting factor keyed to the chi-square drift evidence, keeping old weeks at reduced weight instead of discarding them, since NFL regimes recur (returning QBs, seasonal weather) rather than being truly novel.
gate: ADOPT the detector into the weekly pipeline if, on 2020–2025 nflverse history: (i) PUDD fires ≥1 week earlier than the error-rate baseline on ≥60% of known regime-change episodes, (ii) false-alarm rate ≤2/season, and (iii) the drift-triggered refit policy does not degrade Brier by more than 0.002 vs the frozen baseline on non-drift weeks.

title: Retrieving Classes of Causal Orders with Inconsistent Knowledge Bases (MATS)
improvement: Use MATS as an LLM-based causal hypothesis ranker for GSE research questions only, with self-consistency scores calibrated to empirical conditional-independence test p-values weighting the feedback-arc-set objective — and every MATS-proposed edge must survive a data-based test (CI test or IV check) before it ever enters the engine.
gate: ADAPT as hypothesis-ranker if: the pipeline recovers ≥4/5 known-direction pairs from GSE data AND the enumerated order classes are stable across two different LLMs (rank correlation of pairwise scores >0.7). REJECT any direct use of LLM orders in the engine.

title: Application of the Kelly Criterion to Prediction Markets
improvement: Add the paper's closed-form Kelly certification test as a pre-bet validity gate and run a gap monitor that flags wide price-vs-resolved-frequency gap markets, then empirically map actual gap distributions by liquidity tier on Polymarket/Kalshi to test whether edge concentrates where the paper predicts (wide-gap, low-liquidity, near-certain-investor regimes).
gate: ADOPT the closed-form certification test if it passes (correctness property). ADOPT the gap monitor if flagged high-gap markets show realized ROI significantly below average on held-out data (supporting the pass-on-betting rule). REJECT the monitor otherwise.

title: Generative AI for Banks: Benchmarks and Algorithms for Synthetic Financial Transaction Data
improvement: Adopt the five-category evaluation framework (+ TSTR) as the lane's mandatory acceptance rubric for every GSE synthetic-data generator, and add an explicit graph-reconstruction auxiliary loss (GNN link-prediction head penalizing synthetic tables whose implied matchup graph diverges from the real schedule graph) so every synthetic NFL dataset ships with a NetSimile-vs-real-schedule score.
gate: ADOPT the five-category framework (+ TSTR) as the lane's mandatory acceptance rubric if: (a) the harness reproduces the paper's qualitative ranking on a finance-adjacent sanity dataset (FinDiff ≥ TVAE ≥ CTGAN on fidelity), AND (b) every lane generator can be scored end-to-end; graph experiment target: NetSimile ≤19 while holding column fidelity ≥0.90.

title: Learning Group Interactions and Semantic Intentions for Multi-Object Trajectory Prediction
improvement: Add tactic-conditioned diffusion trajectory prediction to the tracking lane and turn it into a live-pricing scheme-sensitivity engine: generate trajectories under counterfactual defensive schemes (e.g., Cover 2 instead of recognized Cover 3) and widen live-prop uncertainty bands on plays where the factual-vs-counterfactual ΔE[outcome] is large.
gate: Adopt if the tactic-conditioned model beats the unconditioned diffusion baseline by ≥8% minADE on the weeks 17–18 test window AND auxiliary scheme classification Top-1 ≥ 55%; reject if conditioning gains vanish when tactics are recognized (not given).

title: AIFS-CRPS: Ensemble Forecasting Using a Model Trained with a Loss Function Based on CRPS
improvement: Train GSE's weather ensemble models with almost-fair CRPS (afCRPS) and combine it with the threshold-weighted twCRPS idea from ledger 0746 into a threshold-weighted almost-fair CRPS that emphasizes tail outcomes while keeping the degeneracy fix — a combination neither paper tries.
gate: ADOPT afCRPS training if it improves holdout CRPS ≥2% at equal-or-better calibration (PIT uniformity); REJECT if the ensemble collapses (spread → 0) or if gains are <1%.

title: FACTS: Fine-Grained Action Classification for Tactical Sports
improvement: Add a synchronized audio stream (broadcast crowd/whistle/pad-crack audio) as a second modality to the VideoMAE action classifier — a two-tower VideoMAE + audio-MAE model on tackle-type/block-shed labels — so audio disambiguates visually occluded contact frames (tackles, blocks, catches) where pure video confuses classes.
gate: Adopt the video-classification lane if the VideoMAE model beats the pose-based baseline by ≥10 percentage points of test accuracy on the week 16–18 window AND per-class F1 ≥ 0.70 on all 8 classes.

title: Optimizing Fantasy Sports Team Selection with Deep Reinforcement Learning
improvement: Rebuild DFS lineup construction with a two-headed PPO agent: head 1 maximizes projected score (cash-game lineups), head 2 maximizes probability of finishing above the 99th percentile of a field simulator built from public ownership projections (tournament lineups), judged on actual payout EV.
gate: Accept the adaptation if the PPO agent's mean percentile rank over the 8 held-out NFL slates ≥ the optimizer baseline's mean percentile by ≥ 5 points, with the improvement consistent across ≥ 5 of 8 slates.

title: Causal Hangover Effects
improvement: Gate all situational spots (fatigue/hangover-style angles) through an engine-honesty filter before they ever enter the engine — ATS cover rate ≥ 54.5% over ≥200 occurrences, FDR-adjusted p < 0.05, placebo |effect| < 1.5pp, CLV beat-rate > 50% — and estimate the rest effect as a parametric decay over hours-since-exposure (exponential or spline from 4 to 14 days) rather than short-rest dummies, checking whether the market already prices each point on the curve.
gate: Adopt a situational spot into the engine only if: (a) ATS cover rate ≥ 54.5% over ≥200 occurrences with FDR-adjusted p < 0.05, AND (b) the placebo (same spot with ≥10 days rest, or neutral-site analogue) shows |effect| < 1.5pp and is non-significant, AND (c) CLV beat-rate > 50%. Otherwise log as noise and reject.

title: Optimizing for Rotisserie Fantasy Basketball
improvement: Add a tournament-objective mode to the weekly DFS pipeline that replaces the fixed historical payline with an adaptive payline distribution conditional on slate features (total, pace, chalk ownership), maximizing E_payline[Φ((µ−payline)/σ)] by quadrature so high-total shootout slates build the variance they need.
gate: ADOPT the GPP objective into the weekly DFS pipeline only if, on the 2024 17-week backtest, tournament-objective lineups beat max-expectation lineups by ≥ 5 pp in cash rate AND the top-1% hit rate is not worse.

title: Beyond CVaR: Leveraging Static Spectral Risk Measures for Enhanced Decision-Making in Distributional Reinforcement Learning
improvement: Run seasonal bet selection under a Mean-CVaR / static spectral risk measure policy, and learn the risk spectrum from Garrett's actual historical override decisions (fit the (α,w) weights that maximize correlation between the policy's implied weekly risk posture and his overrides) so the risk measure is grounded in demonstrated operator risk tolerance, not an arbitrary choice.
gate: ACCEPT if: on 10k bootstrapped seasons, the Mean-CVaR policy achieves CVaR_{0.2}(season profit) ≥ 1.15 × CVaR_{0.2} of the fixed-threshold baseline AND E[season profit] ≥ 0.95 × baseline expectation (tail protection must cost ≤5% of expectation) AND P(season loss) ≤ 0.8 × baseline.

title: Forecasting Soccer Matches through Distributions
improvement: Replace independent-marginal generative simulation with joint modeling of plays-per-game and EPA-per-play via a copula or conditional model (EPA-per-play | pace decile), since fast high-play games systematically tilt efficiency, to fix the extreme-tail (blowout) miscalibration that independent sampling produces.
gate: Adopt the simulation-pipeline variant if, on walk-forward 2024 weeks 1–18, its moneyline Brier score beats the bookmaker-consensus-implied Brier by ≥0.002 AND beats GSE's current engine Brier by ≥0.002. Reject if it trails the bookmaker baseline.

title: Unsupervised Feature Construction for Anomaly Detection in Time Series — An Evaluation
improvement: Detect steam/shock windows on odds trajectories with a window→catch22→isolation-forest pipeline using jumping (non-overlapping) windows and automatic W selection via FFT-based periodicity detection adapted to weekly sports cadence (7-day odds seasonality, 1-game EPA cadence), which runs at ~1/30th the feature count of tsfresh and is real-time-capable.
gate: Adopt the window→tsfresh→IF shock detector iff on the 2024–2025 odds-trajectory test it achieves AUC ≥ 0.70 on steam/shock windows AND beats raw-window IF with Wilcoxon p < 0.05, with per-window inference cost < 5 s.

title: Predict Confidently, Predict Right: Abstention in Dynamic Graph Learning
improvement: Replace the fixed quadratic coverage penalty in GSE's learned abstention head with a Lagrangian dual update (learn λ online to pin exact coverage) and split coverage budgets per market (spread vs total vs moneyline get separate θ), since abstention value differs by market edge distribution.
gate: ADOPT the method iff, at matched realized coverage (±2 pts), the selection-head model's selective ROI beats the softmax-threshold baseline by ≥ 3 ROI points on the chronological test block AND realized coverage stays within ±3 pts of target across the last 4 weeks of data.

title: Disentangled Interleaving Variational Encoding
improvement: Adopt a disentangled multi-task architecture for the win/spread/total heads, replacing the Naïve-Bayes marginal loss with a supervised contrastive loss on regime labels (dropping the paper's failed conditional-independence assumption) and learning noisy regime labels jointly via a VQ-VAE codebook instead of hand labels.
gate: Adopt the architecture if, on 2024–2025 walk-forward, the disentangled multi-task model beats the non-disentangled shared-encoder baseline by ≥0.003 Brier (win prob) or ≥0.1 points MAE vs. close on spread/total, AND achieves MIG ≥ 2× the baseline's.

title: An optimal transport based embedding to quantify the distance between playing styles in collective sports
improvement: Build GSE's team-style similarity engine on sliced-Wasserstein embeddings, but quantize the league-wide frame pool once into a shared codebook of formation atoms ("Cover-2 shell", "bunch trips") and represent each team as a histogram over shared atoms — team similarity becomes a cheap Hellinger distance and the atoms give a human-readable formation taxonomy for free.
gate: ADOPT the sliced-Wasserstein embedding + quantization pipeline as GSE's team-style similarity engine if the NGS pilot reproduces two paper signatures: (i) embedding beats raw-coordinate baselines on a formation-label prediction task by ≥10 pp, and (ii) the resulting 32×32 similarity matrix correlates ≥0.5 with an independent style proxy (e.g., charted man/zone rates).

title: Martingale Approach to Gambler's Ruin Problem for Correlated Random Walks
improvement: Replace the i.i.d. gambler's-ruin bankroll gate with the exact streak-aware ruin formula for correlated weekly P&L signs (fitted 2-state Markov chain), probing a numerically fitted 2nd-order chain to see whether ruin probability moves materially vs k=1 — a direct cheap upgrade to GSE's bankroll gates when weekly results are serially correlated.
gate: ADOPT the streak-aware gate if the engine's weekly signs show significant persistence (|p − 1/2| > 0.05, binomial test) AND the CRW α differs from the i.i.d. value by > 20% relative (i.e., the correction matters); REJECT if weekly signs are statistically independent.

title: One Fits All: General Mobility Trajectory Modeling via Masked Conditional Diffusion (GenMove)
improvement: Generate synthetic NFL plays with a masked conditional diffusion trajectory model using a formation/personnel controller (11 personnel, shotgun, motion flags) instead of radius-of-gyration, and condition on defensive look (blitz indicators) to generate the offensive plays most likely to exploit it — a direct coaching/scouting tool whose conditional charted-concept distributions must match real ones.
gate: ADOPT if: (a) generated-play JSD ≤ 0.15 on yards-gained distribution (vs ≥ 0.25 for a Markov baseline), AND (b) zero-shot long-horizon prediction on unseen teams beats the best baseline by ≥ 10% Accuracy@5.

title: Data-Juicer 2.0: Cloud-Scale Adaptive Data Processing for and with Foundation Models
improvement: Fuse GSE's multi-pass nflverse+corpus processing scripts into a single-pass dedup+filter pipeline with MinHash near-duplicate detection, plus a probe-small-batches adapter (run dedup+filter on a 1% sample to select chunk size and operator order, then apply to the full corpus) to test whether adaptive probing pays off even at GSE's scale.
gate: ADAPT the patterns iff the fused single-pass pipeline runs ≥30% faster than the current multi-pass scripts on the nflverse+arXiv corpora AND MinHash finds ≥5 near-duplicate pairs missed by exact hashing; reject any Ray/cluster adoption.

title: Efficient inference of rankings from multi-body comparisons
improvement: Model division winners with position-1-breaking Plackett-Luce and extend to the full NFL playoff seed order (7 seeds × 2 conferences, 2002–2025) to test whether entire seed orders carry joint information worth modeling, or whether pairwise/first-place-only structure suffices as in the paper's APA result.
gate: Adopt position-1-breaking PL for division-winner modeling if, on the 2021–2025 time-ordered test, it matches or beats the market baseline on log-loss (within 0.02) AND beats pairwise BT on top-1 hit rate by ≥1 additional correct division.

title: Temporal Dynamics of Goal Scoring in Soccer
improvement: Add a score-differential × clock burstiness interaction to the live total model: compute same-team burstiness as a function of score differential and time remaining (is the surge stronger when trailing?), turning the paper's pooled burstiness finding into a game-state-conditioned live intensity.
gate: Adopt if the same-team burstiness effect survives team-strength conditioning — i.e., observed same-team next-score rate in the first 5 minutes after a score exceeds the conditioned null by ≥ 15% relative with χ² p < 0.01 — AND the burstiness-adjusted live intensity improves 2025 second-half total log-loss by ≥ 0.01 nats over the base Poisson model.

title: A Scalable Solver for 2p0s Differential Games with One-Sided Payoff Information and Continuous Actions, States, and Time
improvement: Model play-calling as a one-sided-information game with a ≤2-atom mixture (concealment dynamics), then extend to a repeated game where the defense updates its belief about the offense's type distribution within a drive/game — testing whether belief-updating equilibrium predicts within-game play-calling shifts (e.g., run tendency after two consecutive passes) better than a static model, with adversarial 4th-down modeling as the next step.
gate: Adopt if the ≤2-atom mixture model beats the logistic baseline by ≥ 0.005 nats of log-loss (or ≥ 0.002 Brier) on 2025 holdout play-by-play, AND a companion deviation analysis shows at least 3 teams with statistically significant (p < 0.05, Bonferroni-corrected) deviations between equilibrium-implied and empirical mixes in any single 2025 game-state bin.

title: Statistical Enhanced Learning for Modeling and Prediction of Tennis Matches at Grand Slam Tournaments
improvement: Adopt the enhanced feature set over the Elo-only logistic baseline for game-outcome modeling, and learn the shape of the age transform empirically — fit a 1D P-spline on QB age and roster mean age inside a GAM, then distill the fitted spline into a piecewise-linear feature — instead of hand-picking |age−30| / [28,32], producing an interpretable age-curve artifact.
gate: ADOPT the enhanced feature set if, pre-registered: pooled held-out log-loss improves by ≥ 0.005 over the Elo-only logistic baseline AND the gain appears in ≥ 5 of 7 held-out seasons (consistency, not one lucky year).

title: OpenSTARLab: Open Approach for Spatio-Temporal Agent Data Analysis in Soccer
improvement: Adopt the UIED/SAR schema pattern for GSE's data layer (nflverse + NGS into a single queryable play/frame schema), and replace sparse terminal EPV rewards with dense per-frame reward shaping (per-frame ΔEPA) for any GSE off-ball multi-agent valuation work, addressing paper 0372's off-ball credit-assignment gap.
gate: ADOPT the UIED/SAR schema pattern for GSE's data layer if a 2-week prototype converts nflverse + NGS into a single queryable play/frame schema with <1% row loss on joins; REJECT porting any OpenSTARLab model to NFL data.

title: Learning Conformal Abstention Policies for Adaptive Risk Management in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
improvement: Adopt the two-threshold conformal abstention structure with market-conditional (α, β) per market (spread/total/moneyline) rather than a single global β — moneyline underdogs and totals have different uncertainty geometry — to recover posted picks a global threshold over-abstains on.
gate: ADAPT iff the three-way policy's selective ROI exceeds the single-threshold conformal baseline by ≥ 2 ROI points on the test block while realized coverage stays ≥ 90% and the abstention rate stays ≤ 25%; REJECT the RL-tuning component unconditionally.

title: Beyond Confidence: Adaptive Abstention in Dual-Threshold Conformal Prediction for Autonomous System Perception
improvement: Replace the fixed 70%-confidence abstention cutoff with an ROC-tuned dual-threshold conformal policy, and fit separate (q̂_conf, q̂_abs) thresholds per game regime (divisional/non-divisional, weather-affected, short-week) to attack the marginal-vs-conditional coverage gap the paper cites.
gate: ADAPT if the ROC-tuned abstention threshold beats a fixed 70%-confidence cutoff on test-window published ROI by ≥1pp at comparable coverage, with empirical coverage within ±3pp of the 1−α target.

title: Forecasting the Future Development in Quality and Value of Professional Football Players
improvement: Add a player-development forecaster to the projection pipeline with a hierarchical mixed-effects age curve: fit a position-specific Bayesian aging curve first and feed each player's residual-vs-curve as the feature, separating age-expected decline from true development signal — targeting the volatile under-24 slice where the paper's models were weakest.
gate: ADOPT the development forecaster + its intervals into GSE's projection pipeline only if: (a) ≥10% RMSE improvement over carry-forward on 2023–2024 test for at least 3 of 4 positions, (b) empirical 80%-interval coverage within 75–85%, and (c) subgroup slices show no catastrophic failure (RMSE on 2nd-year breakouts no worse than 1.3× overall RMSE).

title: Increasing competitiveness by imbalanced groups: The example of the 48-team FIFA World Cup
improvement: Add an incentive-discount adjustment for stakeless games with a dynamic dose-response: estimate how the favorite's underperformance scales with (a) fraction of starters rested (snap-share data), (b) days of rest differential, and (c) whether the opponent is also stakeless — fit hierarchically across teams to find coaches with persistent incentive-effect signatures GSE can price every January.
gate: Adopt the incentive-discount adjustment if, on the 2025 test window (Weeks 15–18), the adjusted model beats the baseline by ≥1.5 percentage points of ATS cover rate OR reduces margin MAE by ≥0.4 points, with the stakeless×weight interaction coefficient significant at p<0.05 on the 2020–2024 fit.

title: Metamorphic Testing for Pose Estimation Systems
improvement: Adopt MeT-Pose as the mandatory pre-deployment QA gate for any GSE pose estimator — complementing, not replacing, a small labeled benchmark — and add a temporal-consistency rule family the paper omits: flag frames where any keypoint's frame-to-frame displacement exceeds a sport-specific percentile (e.g., 99th percentile of per-keypoint speed from clean data) to catch jitter/dropout faults in All-22 video.
gate: ADOPT MeT-Pose as the mandatory pre-deployment QA gate for any GSE pose estimator if the pilot shows the suite catches ≥80% of the faults found by a 50-frame hand-labeled GT test while requiring no additional labels; REJECT as the sole QA method regardless.

title: Instrumented Mouthguards for Head Acceleration Events in NCAA Football
improvement: Add cumulative head-acceleration-exposure features (imputed from position-group exposure priors) to DNP/availability models, and test whether the offense-side high-magnitude asymmetry (2.6 >30g events/game) predicts measurable late-season offensive-efficiency degradation for high-contact positions (RB/WR/TE) — turning a measurement study into a live fantasy/pick edge while never presenting HAE rates as injury probabilities.
gate: ADAPT the exposure priors if: the exposure feature improves DNP log-loss by ≥0.003 on the 2025 holdout with monotone direction across position groups. REJECT any direct injury-probability claim.

title: AlphaAgent: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining with Regularized Exploration to Counteract Alpha Decay
improvement: Mine alphas with an LLM agent using crowding-aware fitness — penalize similarity to a public-signal proxy zoo (formulas reconstructed from public analytics discourse) so signals resembling what the market already knows (e.g., PFF's public grades) are killed — and make the alignment judge adversarial, with a second LLM arguing against each hypothesis and only survivors kept.
gate: ADAPT→build if regularized mining shows (a) slower per-season RankIC decay (decay slope ≥ 30% flatter) AND (b) mean pairwise AST similarity ≤ 0.5 vs. ≥ 0.7 unregularized, with test Brier no worse than unregularized. REJECT if regularizers only reduce similarity cosmetically while decay rates match.

title: Towards long-term player tracking with graph hierarchies and domain-specific features
improvement: Adopt jersey-number + team-ID + field-coordinate edge features for any GSE video-tracking prototype, with a constant-velocity Kalman predictor on field coordinates gating edge creation (only connect tracklets whose predicted positions overlap within a radius) — motion being the cue that survives jersey illegibility.
gate: ADOPT the jersey-number + team-ID + field-coordinate feature set for any GSE video-tracking prototype only if a pilot on 10 NFL broadcast plays shows jersey-number OCR legibility ≥60% of player-frames and the combined edge features reduce ID switches vs ByteTrack alone by ≥25%.

title: What Influences the Field Goal Attempts of Professional Players in Basketball? A Spatially Varying Joint Model
