improvement: Model route-target selection as a spatial point process (JSVLGCP 1D port) and extend it to a marked point process with EPA as the mark — E[target EPA | location, covariates] modeled jointly with attempt intensity — producing a spatial expected-points surface for route concepts that feeds GSE's EPA machinery.
gate: ADOPT the 1D port if, before running: JSVLGCP held-out NLL beats KDE by ≥ 0.02 nats/attempt with SE excluding zero across the 10 seeds, AND the estimated β surfaces show coherent structure (e.g., deeper targets vs weak opponents). REJECT the port if the NLL gap is < 0.01 nats/attempt or the surfaces are noise.

title: Gate-Shift-Pose: Enhancing Action Recognition in Sports with Skeleton Information
improvement: Fuse skeleton information into the GSF action-recognition backbone with a learned spatial encoder — a small conv net mapping (x,y,confidence)^17 to a 16-channel spatial prior trained jointly — replacing the handcrafted Gaussian heatmap, and test YOLO11-n-pose plus early fusion for the latency–accuracy tradeoff on edge hardware.
gate: Both GSP variants must beat the RGB-only baseline by ≥10pp mean accuracy on athlete-disjoint folds AND the early-fusion-vs-late-fusion ranking must hold (ResNet50: early ≥ late; ResNet18: late ≥ early) [index numeric_gate, truncated].

title: Optimal Diversification and Leverage in a Utility-Based Portfolio Allocation Approach
improvement: Rebuild the sizer as a two-knob portfolio: exponential-utility diversification weights w* (compound covariance) plus GMV log-utility leverage f* — with the utility-variance penalty λ made state-dependent, scaling up when the engine's recent calibration error (ECE) is high so leverage auto-tempers when probabilities are unreliable, turning the static half-Kelly rule into a calibration-aware dial.
gate: ADOPT the two-knob sizer if it beats half-Kelly independent staking on terminal log growth with max drawdown ≤ half-Kelly's over 2023–2025, AND the fitted GMV leverage ratio f*/f_Kelly falls in [0.3, 0.7] consistently (validating the natural half-Kelly claim on sports data).

title: AthletePose3D: A Benchmark Dataset for 3D Human Pose Estimation and Kinematic Validation in Athletic Movements
improvement: Fine-tune a 3D pose lifter on the AthletePose3D benchmark with broadcast-style degradation augmentation (25 FPS, motion blur, compression artifacts) added to training data to close the lab→broadcast gap, measured on real NFL clips before pose-derived kinematics are allowed in any product or published analysis.
gate: GSE's NFL fine-tuned lifter must reach P-MPJPE ≤ 35 mm on a held-out NFL broadcast clip set (matching the paper's best 29.91 mm regime) AND joint-angle waveform correlation r ≥ 0.8 against any available ground truth before GSE uses pose-derived kinematics in any product or published analysis.

title: AFBART: Adaptive Functional Bayesian Additive Regression Trees for Shot Intensity Surfaces
improvement: Adopt AFBART adaptive-basis functional BART as GSE's nonparametric target-diet regression (route/target-intensity surfaces) with calibrated uncertainty, upgrading to single-stage joint LGCP+AFBART inference and half-court-geometry-aware bases for the field.
gate: Gate (ADAPT): wins all 6 simulation settings on all 3 metrics (e.g., RMSPE 0.07 vs. 0.68) and wins the real-data 4-fold CV on both RMSPE and MCRPS. Improvement success = RMSPE ≤ 0.30 on Case 3 (vs. paper's 0.34) with no degradation in MIS/MCRPS.

title: PassAI: explainable artificial intelligence algorithm for soccer pass analysis using multimodal information resources
improvement: Build temporal PassAI for NFL pass-completion prediction: replace the single-frame image stream with a 5-frame sequence (snap, mid-drop, throw, catch-point, +0.5s) processed by a TimeSformer/VideoSwin stream alongside the stats MLP, targeting the failed-pass recall class (currently 70.8%) that single frames cannot fix.
gate: ACCEPT: two-stream model beats the tracking-only baseline by ≥2 percentage points accuracy AND ≥0.015 AUC on the held-out 2022 test, with the stats stream contributing (mean C_S > 0.2 in stage-1 attributions).

title: Unveiling Hidden Pivotal Players with GoalNet: A GNN-Based Soccer Player Evaluation System
improvement: Attribute per-play ΔEPA to NFL players with a GAT over the 22-player graph, replacing the embedding-magnitude attribution axiom with counterfactual leave-one-out attribution (mask each player's node features, measure the predicted ΔEPA drop) — Shapley-style credit on the trained model that surfaces hidden value in non-skill positions.
gate: Adopt GAT-based play attribution if (a) validation MAE on ΔEPA beats the linear-participation baseline by ≥10% on weeks 13–18, AND (b) the attributed per-game player values correlate with PFF grades at Spearman ρ ≥ 0.4, AND (c) at least 3 of the top-20 season "hidden value" players are non-skill positions with defensible film cases.

title: ChronosX: Adapting Pretrained Time Series Models with Exogenous Variables
improvement: Adopt a pretrained time-series backbone with lightweight adapter blocks for exogenous covariates, keeping the backbone frozen, and add a late-news IIB update that re-runs only the adapter blocks on fresh injury/inactive/weather-nowcast inputs in the final 60 minutes before kickoff — since most covariate value arrives in the last hour.
gate: ADOPT into the engine if adapters beat the covariate-free fine-tuned backbone by ≥0.01 WQL on 2022–2024 AND the ablation (adapters with shuffled covariates) shows no gain; keep the frozen backbone + adapters (don't full-FT) if adapter-only is within 0.005 WQL of full-FT.

title: LLM-FE: Automated Feature Engineering for Tabular Data with LLMs as Evolutionary Optimizers
improvement: Adopt the LLM-FE harness (LLMs as evolutionary optimizers for feature programs) with a two-stage fitness — top-3 programs re-scored on a sequestered second validation season (2022) the LLM never sees during evolution, keeping a program only if it wins on both — and adaptive τ_c annealed from high exploration across the 20-sample budget.
gate: ADOPT the harness iff (a) 2024 held-out log-loss improves ≥ 0.003, AND (b) both ablations replicate the paper's ordering (full > w/o-refinement, full > anonymized), AND (c) zero leakage-audit failures, AND (d) weekly runtime ≤ 6 hours on the VM.

title: Ornstein–Uhlenbeck Process for Horse Race Betting: A Micro–Macro Analysis of Herding and Informed Bettors
improvement: Fit the O–U efficiency-clock to NFL line movement as a market-timing honesty instrument, extended with a delayed-herder class (public bettors reacting to stale lines, f_delay(z_{n−k})) so the model produces a stale-line arbitrage-window detector — the exact moments when public money is betting yesterday's number — that the paper's single-herder model cannot produce.
gate: Adapt the O–U efficiency-clock into GSE's market-timing lane if: (i) the NFL r_inf(n) fit achieves R² ≥ 0.5 with positive Δr on 2023–2025 data; and (ii) a favorite/underdog split shows statistically different r_inf trajectories (Wald test p < 0.05).

title: Neural-Guided Equation Discovery
improvement: Adopt grammar-constrained neural-guided proposals with best-aggregation for GSE's symbolic-regression metric discovery, and learn dataset embeddings (Bi-LSTM trained contrastively on nflverse-table-slice → equation-skeleton pairs) to warm-start new discovery tasks from similar tables — transfer learning across GSE's metric portfolio (e.g., punt-return value warm-starts from kick-return value).
gate: ADOPT grammar-constrained proposals + best-aggregation if GSE-SR valid-program rate rises ≥10pp with no OOD-NMSE regression on the 2024–2025 holdout; REJECT if constraints reduce the diversity of discovered forms (count distinct skeletons — must not drop >20%).

title: 1625 Optimal Betting: Beyond the Long-Term Growth
improvement: Replace the fixed risk-aversion dial with an adaptively refit γ: refit γ each week to maximize trailing-8-week realized Sharpe so the sizer automatically de-risks when edge estimates are miscalibrated in the current regime.
gate: ADOPT if some γ>0 on the 2025–2026 replay achieves realized Sharpe ≥ half-Kelly's with realized growth within 5% of half-Kelly's; otherwise REJECT.

title: ST-VLM: Kinematic Instruction Tuning for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
improvement: Ship a KinQA-tuned vision-language assistant for GSE content work that answers kinematic questions from video, trained on multi-step kinematic reasoning chains grounded in exact NGS labels (e.g., was separation at catch point above league-average NGS separation for this route type?) to exploit the label luxury the paper's pseudo-labeling lacked.
gate: ADOPT the KinQA-tuned assistant for GSE content work only if it reaches ≥55% accuracy on the 5,000-pair held-out set with paraphrased questions AND ≥95% on comparison questions; otherwise REJECT.

title: Simulating Tracking Data to Advance Sports Analytics Research
improvement: Adopt the entity-schema plus event/stint extraction layer for GSE's NGS pipeline, and close the paper's admitted gap quantitatively by computing MMD on player-velocity and spacing distributions between simulated and real NGS frames, measuring the sim-to-real degradation of models trained in simulation as the transferability score gating which model classes are safe to prototype there.
gate: Adopt the entity-schema + event/stint extraction layer for GSE's NGS pipeline if the reproducible test passes (it is pure engineering with no downside); adopt the simulation-first prototyping lane only after identifying a football simulator with adequate behavioral realism.

title: Optimizing Forecast Combination Weights Using Exponentially Weighted Hit and Win Rate Losses
improvement: Set ensemble combination weights with exponentially weighted hit/win-rate losses, upgrading the paper's symmetric win loss to a magnitude-weighted Cauchy surrogate w_t·F_Cauchy(|R_t|−1) with w_t = |actual − consensus| — so the combiner concentrates weight where the CLV dollars are largest, directly optimizing expected CLV instead of win frequency.
gate: ADOPT if on the 2025 holdout the combiner achieves win rate vs. consensus ≥ 55% and beat-the-close rate ≥ 52.5% (the standard -110 breakeven is 52.38%) and Brier score no worse than +1% vs. simple average. REJECT if win rate ≤ 52% or beat-the-close < 52.38%.

title: 1716 AskSport: Web application for sports question-answering
improvement: Ship a sports QA interface on the AskSport contract — answer plus temperature-scaled calibrated confidence, source title and URL, and explicit abstention — with the retrieval-confidence gate (joint calibration of retrieval score × reader confidence as the displayed number) and an abstention experiment on 50 injected unanswerable questions to convert the demo into a deployable product decision.
gate: ADAPT the interface contract only — answer + calibrated confidence + source title + source URL + explicit abstention. ADAPT proceeds if the reproducible test above passes on GSE's corpus; REJECT the raw-softmax confidence display unconditionally.

title: Distributional regression with reject option
improvement: Replace the static ε=0.15–0.2 plug-in rejection budget with a regime-conditional one: allocate larger sit-out fractions to high-entropy regimes (division games, heavy weather, short rest) and smaller ones to clean games, testing whether it improves published ROI over the global ε.
gate: ADAPT if the ε=0.15–0.2 plug-in rule achieves |r̂−ε| ≤ 2pp and beats the no-gate baseline on published-game ROI by ≥1pp with lower CRPS error; adopt the entropy criterion if it also beats the 0700 conformal gate.

title: Automated Explanation of Machine Learning Models of Footballing Actions in Words
improvement: Auto-generate wordalised explanations of the engine's daily output for content drafts (human/voice-gate approval before posting), with deterministic fidelity checking (parse claimed factor directions from text and compare against true contribution signs, no LLM judge) and SHAP-based wordalisation of the actual non-additive model instead of requiring a linear one.
gate: Adopt as a draft-generation step if: (a) sentence-level fidelity ≥ 90% on the 50-pick test, and (b) Garrett's blinded engagement rating favors wordalised by ≥ 0.5 points, and (c) contribution extraction runs automatically on the daily engine output. Reject (keep as reference) if fidelity < 85%.

title: Proper Scoring Rules for Estimation and Forecast Evaluation
improvement: Adopt the proper-scoring framework as GSE's forecast-evaluation doctrine — Brier for cover probabilities, CRPS primary for margin/total distributions, threshold-weighted CRPS for blowout tails — implemented as crps.ts scoring every model version against market-implied distributions weekly, giving a proper-score skill-gap decomposition (where GSE beats the market vs. where it loses) as the weekly model-vs-market scoreboard.
gate: ADOPT CRPS as primary if: model rankings by CRPS are stable across 2023/2024/2025 (Spearman ≥ 0.8 year-to-year) and CRPS-selected models also win on realized betting utility (CLV). REJECT minimum-CRPS training if it degrades NLL-based tail diagnostics (log score) by >10% — keep NLL training, CRPS evaluation.

title: AutoComp: Automated Data Compaction for Log-Structured Tables in Data Lakes
improvement: Add a weekly OPTIMIZE hook for GSE's log-structured tables and replace the weighted-sum compaction objective with an enumerated multi-objective Pareto frontier over (ΔF, GBHr) for all compactable tables weekly, picking the Pareto knee — producing the first empirical Pareto study of compaction trade-offs the authors left as future work.
gate: ADOPT the hook iff: (a) uncompacted 8-week fragmentation degrades the training-path join by ≥ 20% vs post-OPTIMIZE; (b) weekly OPTIMIZE cost < 5% of the weekly build's compute cost; (c) zero write-write conflicts over 4 consecutive weeks of hook operation.

title: TabRep: Roots-of-Unity Categorical Encoding for Unified Tabular Diffusion
improvement: Adopt TabRep (Flow variant, roots-of-unity categorical encoding) as the fast-sampling tabular diffusion backbone, with a learned per-category residual rotation δ_k (small, regularized) on top of Elo-ordered base angles so the geometric prior keeps order semantics while the model fine-tunes angular positions to actual team-similarity structure (dome teams cluster, rival schemes cluster).
gate: ADOPT TabRep (Flow variant) as the fast-sampling backbone if: (a) log-loss gain ≥0.003 on held-out 2024, AND (b) Elo-ordered beats lexicographic on pair-correlation fidelity by ≥10% relative, AND (c) OOI-cast index-0 bias ≤ 25% relative overrepresentation vs uniform.

title: Action Valuation in Sports: A Survey
improvement: Build an expected route value (ERV) model from NGS tracking for off-ball receiver valuation: predict the completion-probability surface over the field given play state, value the actual route as ∫(ERV at actual position − ERV at league-average route) over the play, and sum to a per-player off-ball contribution — the football instantiation of the survey's multi-agent credit-assignment problem that no surveyed paper does for American football.
gate: ADOPT the survey's recommendations into GSE's methods docs only if test (a) shows any alternative horizon beats the drive-level baseline by ≥0.005 AUC on the 2024–2025 out-of-sample window; otherwise record the taxonomy as a reference and REJECT immediate pipeline changes.

title: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search
improvement: Upgrade the nightly signal-discovery loop to a manager-plus-agentic-tree-search with replication discipline and budget-adaptive branch allocation — the manager allocates more branches to hypotheses whose early nodes show high variance across replications (uncertain but promising) and prunes low-variance losers early, finding the same winners at ~50% of the backtest compute.
gate: ADOPT the manager + replication discipline if: (a) ≥80% of signals that pass under the tree+replication protocol still pass on an independent re-run with fresh bootstrap seeds (reproducibility), vs ≤60% for the linear protocol; and (b) the manager's best-node selection agrees with the deterministic evaluator's ranking on ≥90% of stages.

title: Towards Unconstrained 2D Pose Estimation of the Human Spine
improvement: Add SpinePose-style spine-keypoint estimation to the video lane with pad-occlusion augmentation during fine-tuning (randomly mask the torso with jersey-colored rectangles and supervise spine keypoints with higher uncertainty) and a temporal consistency term penalizing frame-to-frame spine-curvature jumps, so curvature can be inferred from shoulder/hip cues when pads hide vertebral cues.
gate: ADOPT the SpinePose fine-tune recipe for a GSE video lane only if replication lands within the §12 tolerances AND the model yields ≥85 AP on a held-out set of football-pad torso images annotated with the nine spine keypoints; otherwise REJECT — pads likely invalidate the paper's claimed generalization.

title: Multi-person Physics-based Pose Estimation for Combat Sports
improvement: Add the iLQR physics-based collision-refinement stage to GSE's pose pipeline, replacing the paper's empirical loss-weight schedule with automated Bayesian weight-tuning over w_1…w_6 and testing capsule-based collision geometry to see whether the Hi4D penetration regression is a geometry-resolution artifact.
gate: ADOPT the iLQR collision-refinement stage only if, on the paper's released supplementary dataset, it beats the kinematics-only baseline by the paper's own margins (≥10% reduction in e_MPJPE and ≥50% reduction in e_foot,vxy); otherwise REJECT.

title: F³Set: Towards Analyzing Fast, Frequent, and Fine-grained Events from Videos
improvement: Build NFL fine-grained event spotting with multi-label factorization and replace the BiGRU context refiner with constrained decoding: a learned NFL play-grammar (down/distance → legal next events) as hard constraints on the event sequence, turning invalid-sequence errors into a guarantee (a touchdown event can only follow a catch/run event).
gate: PURSUE if the pilot reproduces the paper's two structural findings on NFL data: (a) multi-label factorization beats multi-class by ≥ 5 pp F1_evt, and (b) CTX eliminates the invalid-sequence errors the baseline produces; REJECT the architecture if F³ED fails to beat a plain E2E-Spot-style baseline on NFL clips.

title: GridMind: A Multi-Agent NLP Framework for Unified, Cross-Modal NFL Data Insights
improvement: Build GSE's conversational data layer on the GridMind architecture (agent decomposition + RAG + NL-to-SQL + synthesis) as the reference design, closing its two admitted gaps with parallel agent execution plus query-result caching and a deterministic executed-query eval, and add the wordalisation synthesis head on top for the full ask-and-explain loop.
gate: Adopt the architecture (agent decomposition + RAG + NL-to-SQL + synthesis) as GSE's conversational-layer reference design. Do not adopt GridMind itself — no code/data, vendor-locked metrics, 58% accuracy. Kill the fan-facing variant if the eval in §12 doesn't clear 85% accuracy.

title: 1725 Evaluation of the phi-3-mini SLM for identification of texts related to medicine, health, and sports injuries
improvement: Use the SLM strictly as a recall-oriented triage filter in the news cascade — never as a standalone labeler — with Platt/isotonic-calibrated 1–10 scores, thresholds re-tuned on calibrated probabilities, a reporter-specialty prior multiplied into the score, and a fine-tuned BERT-class classifier baseline to test whether the smaller model beats the SLM at 1/10th the inference cost.
gate: ADAPT strictly as a recall-oriented triage filter in a cascade — never as a standalone labeler. ADAPT proceeds if the reproducible test shows recall ≥ 0.95 at an affordable operating point.

title: Enhancing Classifier Evaluation: A Fairer Benchmarking Strategy Based on Ability and Robustness
improvement: Add an IRT-for-games evaluation layer with a graded ordinal response model (beat close by >3 pts / beat close / miss close / miss badly) that credits how much a model beat the market, turning the Glicko tournament into a money-weighted ranking tied to CLV magnitude instead of plain hit rate.
gate: Adopt IRT-for-games as a GSE model-evaluation layer if (a) per-game difficulty is temporally stable (r ≥ 0.5 across disjoint season blocks) AND (b) the IRT ability ranking of engine versions matches the Glicko-2 ranking and both disagree with plain accuracy by at least one rank flip among the top 3.

title: Efficient 2D to Full 3D Human Pose Uplifting including Joint Rotations
improvement: Build full 3D pose uplifting (including joint rotations) for the video lane, removing the biggest deployment blocker by estimating per-player body shape from a few frames via the A2B anthropometric approach and fine-tuning the uplifter jointly with shape estimation instead of requiring GT body shapes.
gate: PURSUE full replication if the plausibility test passes with zero twist failures and end-to-end runtime ≤ 50 ms/frame; REJECT for broadcast use if twist failures persist despite the VPoser prior or the detector pushes the pipeline past 100 ms/frame.

title: SoccerNet-v3D: Leveraging Sports Broadcast Replays for 3D Scene Understanding
improvement: Mint 3D ball and pose ground truth from existing NFL broadcast footage with the paper's annotation-mining recipe — calibration quality gates, reprojection-filtered triangulation, closed-loop box optimizer (engineering directive: optimize size, not center) — the cheapest credible path to 3D ball ground truth for NGS-replacement, with no wearables and no camera rigs.
gate: Ledger states no numeric gate; the transferable asset is the annotation-mining recipe (calibration gates, triangulation, box optimizer), and the football-shape caveat is an adaptation task: the sphere prior (Eq. 7) must be re-derived for a prolate-spheroid football with unknown orientation.

title: LLM-SRBench: A New Benchmark for Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
improvement: Adopt the bench as GSE's symbolic-regression evaluation standard (keeping the OOD-NMSE protocol regardless) and run an obfuscation audit on GSE-SR: algebraically transform 10 previously discovered nflverse equations, hide variable names, and re-run discovery — re-discovery of the transformed forms proves it's discovering, textbook-forms-only proves it's reciting.
gate: ADOPT the bench as GSE's SR evaluation standard if a pilot (10 sports tasks) shows it discriminates between SR variants (≥10pp symbolic-accuracy spread between best and worst variant); REJECT as overkill if all variants score within noise.

title: Can LLMs Leverage Observational Data? Towards Data-Driven Causal Discovery with LLMs
improvement: Build closed-loop LLM causal discovery: the LLM proposes edges from data, PC conditional-independence tests and a probe battery accept/reject them, and rejections are fed back into the prompt as constraints ("V3 does NOT cause V7; propose alternatives"), so the model stops re-proposing statistically-dead edges — with anonymized-label controls separating reasoning gains from memorization.
gate: ADOPT the LLM proposal layer if: (a) anonymized-label LLM F1 ≥ PC F1 on synthetic; (b) LLM priors reduce NOTEARS SHD on synthetic by ≥10% or raise probe hit rate by ≥0.05; (c) per-edge cost stays under $0.50 at 35 vars. Reject if (a) fails.

title: Generalized Visual Relation Detection with Diffusion Models
improvement: Adopt generative open-vocabulary relation decoding with a large rounding vocabulary as GSE's paradigm for semantically ambiguous sports action/event vocabularies (quarterback-releases-ball type relations instead of fixed-class discrimination), evaluated with the T2I-retrieval/SPICE proxy metrics that solve the models-richer-than-annotations evaluation problem.
gate: Ledger states no numeric gate: this is a stills-only research prototype (50 DDIM steps, no sports data, no latency numbers) — the adaptation is conceptual and evaluative, not a pipeline to deploy.

title: Collaborative Multi-Agent RL for Automated Feature Transformation with Graph-Driven Path Optimization (TCTO)
improvement: Make the TCTO graph-driven feature-transformation roadmap temporal: weight roadmap edges by recency (recent seasons' mutual-information scores count more in node-wise pruning) and re-run the multi-agent search each offseason, converting TCTO from a one-shot search into a self-updating feature factory that tests whether discovered interactions are stable across NFL seasons or regime-specific.
gate: Accept the adaptation iff on the 2024 holdout TCTO's discovered feature set improves LightGBM log-loss by ≥ 0.003 over the raw-metric baseline AND matches-or-beats exhaustive pairwise crosses with ≤ half the feature count.

title: TimeSoccer: An End-to-End Multimodal Large Language Model for Soccer Commentary Generation
improvement: Build end-to-end NFL commentary generation with an MLLM trained on GSE's recipe, adopting the paper's training-free MoFA-Select compression module, adding a jersey-number detection head for player-identity grounding (fixing the anonymity limitation), and testing MoFA-Select standalone as a motion-budget-driven highlight-clip selector.
gate: ACCEPTED (ADAPT): first end-to-end SDVC MLLM + training-free reusable compression module + systematic ablations. ADAPT (not ADOPT): no code release, soccer-only, modest absolute precision — adopt the MoFA-Select module and training recipe, retrain the MLLM on NFL data.

title: Relative Advantage: Quantifying Performance in Noisy Competitive Settings
improvement: Replace absolute team-stat features with relative-difference features and model differential environmental sensitivity: estimate team-specific environmental loadings η_i = λ_i·η and use the adjusted relative metric R_adj = (X_A − λ̂_A η̂) − (X_B − λ̂_B η̂), so a dome team's stats in wind are discounted differently than its opponent's — the heterogeneous-environment extension the authors list as future work.
gate: Adopt the principle if relative-difference features beat the two-feature absolute baseline on held-out 2024–2025 NFL games by ≥ 0.01 AUC on log-loss-neutral comparison.

title: Can Geometry Save Central Views for Sports Field Registration?
improvement: Re-derive the pole-polar correspondence trick for the NFL's parallel yard-line primitive (two parallel lines fix a vanishing point; hash-mark ticks at known 1-yard spacing along a known world line construct the pole-polar analog), generating virtual correspondences for field registration without any circle primitive.
gate: ADOPT the pole-polar correspondence trick only if, on the 50-still NFL set, the derived correspondences reduce MRE by ≥20% vs the line-only baseline, or enable calibration on ≥10 stills where the line-only baseline has <4 correspondences.

title: LakeVilla: Multi-Table Transactions for Lakehouses
improvement: Adopt the LakeVilla manifest pattern for multi-table atomicity in GSE's lakehouse builds, then log one full season's commit latencies and orphan-sweep results to publish the first public "multi-table atomicity at small-team scale" operational record — the data point the paper's enterprise numbers lack.
gate: ADOPT the manifest pattern iff: (a) the kill-mid-write test passes 10/10 runs; (b) orphan sweep runs clean weekly with zero false positives for 4 weeks; (c) manifest-flip + read-path change adds < 1% to build wall-clock. REJECT full LakeVilla beyond the pattern.

title: Preference-centric Bandits: Optimality of Mixtures and Regret-efficient Algorithms
improvement: Allocate weekly stakes with the CVaR preference-mixture selector over GSE's own pick history (Neon picks table, model v5.2.7, SPREAD/MONEYLINE/TOTAL): walk-forward comparison of (a) PM mixture allocation vs (b) quarter-Kelly on the single highest-edge pick — the mixture should achieve strictly better preference-mixture value (lower drawdown at similar growth) than any solitary pick when outcomes are heterogeneous.
gate: At T=60k under GD on the paper's 2-arm Bernoulli setup, PM-UCB-M's average regret must be ≤ 50% of uniform sampling's average regret, with regret decreasing monotonically across T∈{20k,40k,60k}.

title: Optimal Blackjack Betting Strategies Through Dynamic Programming and Expected Utility Theory
improvement: Solve a per-pick stake MDP per season (CRRA utility) and distill linear-in-edge staking rules for GSE's per-pick stakes, then re-solve the DP on expected utility under the engine's posterior over edge — testing whether internalizing edge uncertainty flattens the policy the way the paper's α-dial does, yielding a single calibration-driven staking rule instead of a hand-picked α.
gate: ADOPT the DP-distilled linear staking rule if it beats half-Kelly on terminal log growth with max drawdown ≤ half-Kelly's across the 2023–2025 second-half windows, and the distilled slope m is within 25% of the Kelly slope; REJECT otherwise.

title: Data-Driven Team Selection in Fantasy Premier League Using Integer Programming and Predictive Modeling Approach
improvement: Adopt the IP optimizer for the weekly DFS packet with correlation-aware stacking built into the objective — bonus term λ·Σ_{(qb,wr)} corr_{qb,wr}·x_qb·x_wr linearized with auxiliary binaries, tuned on 2022–2023 and tested on 2024–2025 — the tournament edge the paper's plain formulation omits.
gate: ADOPT the IP optimizer into the weekly DFS packet iff it beats the greedy baseline's realized score in ≥ 60% of 2022–2025 slates AND the weighted-average-vs-current-projection bake-off winner is documented with a ≥ 3% mean-score edge. Otherwise REJECT.

title: Decision Making under Model Misspecification: DRO with Robust Bayesian Ambiguity Sets
improvement: Replace standard Kelly with robust Kelly under MMD-ball ambiguity sets, using an adaptive ε per game from the misspecification detector (high MMD distance → larger ambiguity ball) and a learned deep kernel on game features so the ball respects football-relevant similarity (divisional games near each other in kernel space) instead of a fixed Gaussian on outcomes.
gate: ACCEPT if walk-forward: final bankroll ≥ 1.1 × best baseline AND max drawdown ≤ 0.85 × best baseline's AND the predicted-vs-realized edge gap is ≤ 0.7 × the standard-Kelly baseline's. REJECT if robust Kelly posts <50% of the baseline's bet volume (degenerate conservatism).

title: Action Spotting and Precise Event Detection in Sports: Datasets, Methods, and Challenges
improvement: Adopt the survey's formal action-spotting task taxonomy with tolerance windows (TAL/AS/PES tiers) and the 17-method leaderboard for video event-detection prototype selection (E2E-Spot/T-DEED/UGL), using the active-learning data-efficiency result (1/3 labels suffice) to de-risk the labeling budget before spending on annotation or training.
gate: Ledger states no numeric gate — a survey; the immediately actionable assets are the taxonomy, the tolerance-window evaluation equations, the 17-method leaderboard, and the 16-dataset catalog (Table II numbers are cross-paper and directional, not gospel).

title: Optimal Prize Design in Parallel Rank-order Contests
improvement: Add a contest-routing layer to GSE's DFS play that selects GPPs by estimated field skill-share from the x(φ) sorting simulation, then extend the model with the missing multi-entry margin (each contestant chooses contest plus #entries with convex costs) to test whether pros buying 150 entries reverses the soft-field ranking — opening a quantitative case for selective GPP shots with duplicated-core/leveraged lineups rather than blanket avoidance.
gate: ADAPT if the offline replay shows routed contest selection beating uniform GPP entry by ≥5 pp ROI over 4 weeks AND the x(φ) sorting simulation reproduces the known qualitative pattern (top-heavy large-field GPPs concentrate the highest estimated skill share).

title: Framing Causal Questions in Sports Analytics: A Tutorial on Estimand Choice Illustrated Through Crossing in Soccer
improvement: Adopt the estimand-first causal protocol as GSE's causal SOP — estimand before estimator — with interference-aware estimands (exposure mappings at the game level to sidestep within-game interference, e.g., the causal effect of a run-heavy game script on fourth-quarter EPA) and Rosenbaum-bounds/E-value sensitivity reporting as standard output so every causal claim ships with "how strong would unmeasured confounding need to be to kill this result."
gate: ADOPT the estimand-first protocol as GSE's causal SOP if the QB-injury replication (§12) passes its balance gate (all SMDs < 10%) and produces an ATT with bootstrap SE that is stable across two independent season-blocks (2016–2020 vs 2021–2024, same sign, overlapping CIs).

title: SoccerChat: Integrating Multimodal Data for Enhanced Soccer Game Understanding
improvement: Build GSE's broadcast-video understanding QA pipeline on the SoccerChat recipe: turn NFL broadcast video into a ~49k-pair QA instruction dataset (the "labeling factory" pattern with the QA-generation layer added), training jointly on multiple datasets rather than sequentially (joint > sequential is the empirical rule) on top of the strongest general pretraining base available.
gate: Ledger states no numeric gate; the durable contributions are the reproducible instruction-dataset pipeline (49,120 QA pairs, 90,834 clips) and the empirical rule that joint multi-dataset training beats sequential fine-tuning.

title: Revisiting Multi-Agent World Modeling from a Diffusion-Inspired Perspective (DIMA)
improvement: Build a diffusion-style multi-agent world model for play simulation that conditions each denoising step on a role+matchup embedding ("WR3 vs CB2 in Cover-3") and reveals agents in football-meaningful orders (ball carrier first, then blockers, then defenders) as a curriculum vs random permutations — testing whether role-aware reveal ordering improves +1s error by 10%+ over uniform permutation sampling.
gate: ADOPT if on held-out 2024 plays: (a) +0.5s mean player position error ≤ 0.8 yards (beats independent baseline by ≥20%), AND (b) reward head predicts play EPA within ±0.75 on ≥70% of plays, AND (c) permutation-invariance holds (order-shuffled rollouts diverge <5% at +1s).

title: STaR-Bets: Sequential Target-Recalculating Bets for Tighter Confidence Intervals
improvement: Replace normal-approximation win-rate confidence intervals with STaR-Bets sequential target-recalculating intervals in the calibration lane: compute STaR-Bets vs normal-approx CIs on win-rate per probability decile of GSE's pick history (Neon picks, model v5.2.7), and count miscalibrated deciles each method flags — quantifying how much sample the tighter valid intervals save before a miscalibration is detected.
gate: At n = 256, Bernoulli(0.3), δ = 0.05, over 1,000 reps: STaR-Bets mean CI width must be ≤ 1.1× the randomized Clopper-Pearson mean width (near-optimality, Fig. 2R) with empirical coverage in [0.93, 0.97] (validity, Fig. 3).

title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
improvement: Build the open-ended self-improving signal-factory: an archive of candidate signals with staging screening (Stage-0/1 discards ideas before the expensive Stage-2 holdout), and make parent selection multi-objective — gate margin, novelty vs archive embedding, lineage productivity, plus a MAP-Elites diversity bonus over signal families (matchup, weather, rest, market-microstructure) to fill the thin lanes the curriculum wants to target.
gate: ADOPT the archive + staging if: arm (b) produces ≥2× the Stage-3-passing signals of arm (a) over 30 nights, ≥1 winner has a failed node in its lineage (stepping stones are real), and Stage-0/1 screening discards ≥70% of ideas before the expensive Stage-2 holdout.

title: Bounded-Abstention Pairwise Learning to Rank
improvement: Add a bounded-abstention pick-selection rule to the posting pipeline: select only picks whose confidence clears a conformalized conditional-risk threshold (Mondrian CP on edge-sign class) so risk estimates carry finite-sample coverage guarantees — replacing the paper's plug-in quantile threshold — and extend from pairwise to listwise (abstain on full slates, not pairs).
gate: ADOPT the rule into the posting pipeline only if, on the 2024–2025 test window, BALToR-selected picks beat the random-selection baseline by ≥1.5 pp hit rate at c=0.70 with empirical coverage within 0.02 of target, and beat the existing confidence-top-N rule (if any) by ≥0.5 pp. Otherwise REJECT.

title: Paired comparison models with strength-dependent ties and order effects
improvement: Adopt strength-dependent tie probabilities for GSE's soccer/NHL/boxing/push lanes — a Davidson-style tie parameter ν that rises with the average strength of the pair (β₁ > 0) rather than a constant ν — and test strength-dependent order (home-field) effects α₁ on NFL, including the HFA × quality interaction only if it improves ATS log-loss by ≥0.003 on 2018–2023 holdout, otherwise keeping flat HFA.
gate: Strength-dependent tie model must beat constant-ν Davidson by ≥ 0.005 out-of-sample 3-way log-loss on EPL 2022–2024 AND the β₁ coefficient must be positive with 95% CI excluding 0.

title: Beyond Winning: Margin of Victory Relative to Expectation Unlocks Accurate Skill Ratings
improvement: Replace the ad-hoc tanh expected-margin curve with a market-informed one: E_MOV = spread-implied expected margin from the closing line, so the update's margin-surprise term becomes "how much the result surprised the market" rather than "how much it surprised our own ratings" — removing the circularity of ratings predicting margins that update ratings and connecting directly to the CLV lane.
gate: ADOPT the margin-surprise update into the team-strength layer if it clears the §12 gate on 2022–2025 NFL hold-out with no tuning after the gate is set. REJECT (do not merge) if it fails either metric, if the tanh fit is unstable across refits (parameter CV > 25%), or if it underperforms linear-MOV Elo.

title: WorldGym: World Model as An Environment for Policy Evaluation
improvement: Build the WorldGym-style harness for deployment decisions — a world-model environment for offline policy evaluation — replacing the single outcome head with a doubly robust estimator that combines the world-model rollout value with a model-free OPE estimator (weighted importance sampling on historical data) to correct the OOD-overestimation bias the authors flagged.
gate: ADOPT the harness for deployment decisions if: (a) Spearman ρ ≥ 0.7 between in-sim and real-backtest policy rankings on held-out 2024 (the paper's r=0.78 bar, rank version), AND (b) the harness identifies the best challenger variant using ≤50% of the real-game sample a pure backtest needs, AND (c) absolute value estimates track real backtest within the paper's reported band.

title: No Train Yet Gain: Towards Generic Multi-Object Tracking in Sports and Beyond
improvement: Adopt the McByte gating pattern for the video-tracking lane and fuse jersey-number OCR confidence as a third association cue alongside the mask: in ambiguity cases prefer the tracklet–detection pair whose OCR number matches the tracklet's majority-vote number — testing whether a football-specific identity cue beats the generic mask cue in same-uniform piles where masks are least reliable.
gate: ADOPT the McByte gating pattern if the McByte variant reduces ID switches by ≥ 30% vs ByteTrack on the 3-segment window with HOTA ≥ baseline; REJECT (keep ByteTrack/OC-SORT) if the gain is < 10% or throughput falls below 10 FPS offline-batch equivalent.

title: DIAMOND: An LLM-Driven Agent for Context-Aware Baseball Highlight Summarization
improvement: Port DIAMOND to NFL as the automated first pass for weekly recap content and clip selection: replace the paper's hand-set scoring heuristics (1–60 bands, +1..+20 LLM adjustments, LI rank bonus) with a learned ranker trained on (play features, LLM narrative embedding) → human preference labels from GSE's own recap-selection history, optimizing pairwise ranking loss against broadcast ground truth.
gate: ADOPT as a GSE content tool if the NFL port beats WPA-only selection on F1 (≥5pp) and blinded narrative preference (≥60%) on the 20-game test; REJECT the LLM stages if no gain — ship the WPA+LI selector alone.

title: Partially Regularized Ordinal Regression to Adjust Teams' Scoring for Strength of Schedule and Complementary Unit Performance in American Football
improvement: Add punter/kicker-specific field-position value (expected post-punt/kickoff starting position given returner and coverage units) to the partially-regularized ordinal-regression scoring model's complementary feature set — testing whether return-game quality is a stable, predictive team trait that survives the elastic-net selection across seasons.
gate: Adopt complementary features permanently if 10-fold CV on 2015–2024 shows MAE improvement with SE bars non-overlapping vs GS+SoS in ≥4 of 10 seasons; otherwise keep SoS-only.

title: SportMamba Multi-Object Tracking
improvement: Adopt SportMamba's association design with jersey-number-conditioned association: replace the generic Re-ID embedding with a two-stream identity (a) a jersey-number OCR head producing a number posterior per detection and (b) team-side classification via jersey color clustering per game — association cost becomes a weighted sum of HA-EIoU, number-posterior agreement, and team agreement, attacking the paper's stated failure mode of near-identical uniforms.
gate: ADOPT the association design for GSE's video-tracking lane only if: on the football annotation set, the SportMamba-style pipeline beats ByteTrack by ≥ 3.0 HOTA points with the same detector, and the gain concentrates on occlusion-heavy plays.

title: DrSR: LLM based Scientific Equation Discovery with Dual Reasoning from Data and Experience
improvement: Add the DrSR dual-reasoning loop (insight extraction π_data + idea generation from experience) to GSE-SR and run an analyst-in-the-loop insight audit: present π_data's structured insights to a human analyst weekly as "what the machine thinks it's learning about football," turning the module into a discovery communication channel whose insights (e.g., "pressure rate residuals spike in dome games") may surface real football hypotheses even when the equations disappoint.
gate: ADOPT dual reasoning if full DrSR-style beats plain GSE-SR by ≥15% OOD NMSE on 2024–2025 AND valid-program rate ≥90% (vs whatever plain achieves); REJECT if the insight/idea modules add cost without ≥15% gain.

title: Where Is The Ball: 3D Ball Trajectory Estimation From 2D Monocular Tracking
improvement: Replace the ballistic-only simulation with a 6-DoF football flight model including angular velocity state (spiral rate, wobble) and Magnus coefficients fit from NFL Next Gen Stats kick data, adding spin as a latent variable the end-of-trajectory network must implicitly detect from 2D wobble signatures — testing whether explicit orientation dynamics beat the sphere-assumption sim-to-real transfer on tumbling punts while matching on stable kickoffs.
gate: ADOPT the architecture if, on held-out real NFL kick/punt sequences with 2D tracks from broadcast video: (a) landing-spot error ≤ 1.5 yards mean absolute error, AND (b) beats the fitted-physics baseline by ≥25% on landing error, AND (c) sim-trained weights transfer (no more than 2× error inflation from synthetic validation to real).

title: Egocentric Event-Based Vision for Ping Pong Ball Trajectory Prediction
improvement: Adapt the event-based ball trajectory predictor to football flight with a drag+EKF model plus a Magnus/lift term whose spin-axis parameter is estimated from the ball ellipse's rotation across frames — testing whether spin-aware prediction beats drag-only on punts (highest spin) vs kickoffs.
gate: PURSUE the football flight-model adaptation if the drag+EKF model beats the constant-velocity baseline by ≥ 2 m on landing-point RMSE over the 20-clip window; otherwise REJECT and treat ball-flight estimation as buy-not-build (NGS air-distance family).

title: A Bayesian analysis of home advantage in professional squash
improvement: Build a hierarchical Bayesian home model with team-specific home deviations (instead of a constant home field) plus an attendance/capacity-utilization interaction — testing whether real home-effect heterogeneity exists across NFL teams and how much of it crowds explain.
gate: Gate (ADAPT→keep): hierarchical home model beats constant-home baseline by ≥ 0.004 log-loss on 2022–2024 holdout AND ≥3 teams show |home deviation| > 2× posterior SD (i.e., real heterogeneity exists). Otherwise REJECT (keep constant home field).

title: Time-Varying Home Field Advantage in Football: Learning from a Non-Stationary Causal Process
improvement: Replace the engine's static home-field number with a DYNAMO-style non-stationary causal learner that tracks how home advantage drifts over time, feeding DYNAMO-predicted per-drive expected points into the calibration layer so home edge is a time-varying causal quantity rather than a constant.
gate: Adopt the method for GSE only if, on the NFL reproducibility test, DYNAMO-predicted per-drive xP achieves MSE at least 10% lower than the raw-xP baseline on held-out weeks (the paper's Arsenal 2021-22 improvement, ≈29%, sets the bar; below 10% the complexity is not worth the NFL pipeline cost).
